Fixed certificate name-constraint errors being retried for minutes; they now fail at once with a message that says what to fix
Fixed start-up requests switching from an organization's managed proxy and CA settings to user-set ones when a read of the managed settings file failed
Fixed `claude doctor` and `/status` saying a linked managed settings file is still read when it could not be read
Improved sign-in errors in `/login` and `claude setup-token` for a rejected, unreachable or timed-out request: they now say what happened and what to check
Changed organization settings and policy requests to no longer use a proxy set only by `ALL_PROXY`; set `HTTPS_PROXY` if your network needs a proxy for them
Changed Claude Code's own ripgrep and most internal git commands to run without most of its sign-in tokens and API keys, so a credential helper or hook under such a git command no longer finds them
Changed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks to check a plugin file for secret keys before sending it, and to ask first if it may hold one

title.zh-TW: 工作階段復原與工作樹跳轉修復，保障對話歷史完整
title.en: Session resume and worktree jump fixes protect conversation history

body.zh-TW: 接續工作時，紀錄不該遺失。啟動程式可設 CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND，讓退出提示顯示自己的恢復指令。換目錄後，cleanupPeriodDays 到期也清暫存。NFS／FUSE 檔案系統丟棄回覆時不再遺失部分紀錄。claude --teleport 找不到歷史不開空工作階段；claude -p --teleport 恢復失敗會報錯。新訊息打斷傳檔會說對原因。CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN 不重跑掛鉤（事件觸發程式）continue: false 停止的回合。遠端清單納入首次提交前 git add -N 的檔案。CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC 清理遇並行改寫不再丟訊息。
body.en: When resuming work, history should not be lost. A launching program can set CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND so the exit hint shows its own resume command. After changing directories, temporary files are still cleaned up when cleanupPeriodDays expires. Discarding a reply on NFS or FUSE file systems no longer loses part of the saved history. claude --teleport no longer opens an empty session when history is not found, and claude -p --teleport reports an error if resuming fails. Interrupting a file transfer with a new message now states the right reason. CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN no longer reruns turns stopped by a hook (an event-triggered program) returning continue: false. Remote lists now include files added with git add -N before the first commit. CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC no longer drops messages during concurrent rewrites while trimming.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND`, which a program that starts Claude Code can set to have the exit hint name its own resume command
Fixed running `/compact` again, or after a command such as `/context`, summarizing away a message that Claude had not answered yet
Fixed a resumed session joining your next message to an old interrupted message that was not resumed
Fixed `ExitWorktree`, the worktree exit dialog and `/resume` leaving the session in the wrong folder when the folder the shell was in before entering the worktree had been deleted
Fixed `ps` processes piling up when the process listing Claude Code runs before stopping a command takes too long
Fixed subagent transcripts and large tool results being saved apart from the session's transcript after entering a worktree created by a `WorktreeCreate` hook or belonging to a nested repository
Fixed temporary files of a session that had changed directory being left behind when the session expired under `cleanupPeriodDays`
Fixed a case where part of a saved session could be lost on NFS or FUSE file systems when Claude Code discarded a reply
Fixed `claude --teleport` opening an empty session when the server could not find the session's history, and `claude -p --teleport` exiting without an error when the resume failed
Fixed Claude giving a wrong reason when a new message interrupted a file it was sending you
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that a hook's `continue: false` had stopped
Fixed the changed-files list of remote sessions leaving out files added with `git add -N` before the first commit
Fixed the `/rewind` list on network paths and hung folders: it named every tracked file as changed, was slow to show labels, and showed none at all when a file read never returned
Fixed a case where pressing Ctrl+C just as `claude update` finished removed the `claude` command
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when another process rewrote the file while it was being trimmed

title.zh-TW: 本機工作階段互通放寬至十萬則，增強代理協同控制
title.en: Local Session Messaging Raised to 100,000, Strengthening Agent Coordination

body.zh-TW: 同一台電腦上的多個工作階段互傳訊息時，免手動提示的額度由約 20 則升至 100,000 則，Desktop Code 分頁也適用。密集訊息不再卡成忙碌；claude agents 的狀態與輸入通知修正。Esc 按兩次才清提示，ctrl+y 可復原。claude attach、claude agents 用 Ctrl+B 後須在 800 毫秒內按 d 才轉背景。背景服務啟動時未帶 DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING，也會繼承工作階段啟動 shell 的值。claude rm 與代理檢視改說「從清單移除」，不刪對話，claude --resume 仍找得到。分割視窗代理核驗組長，組長結束便拒絕請求；/clear、/resume 後計畫須重送核准。應用程式標為非手打的工作流程提示，不再當作你的請求。
body.en: When multiple sessions on the same machine send messages to each other, the quota without a manual prompt increases from about 20 to 100,000 messages, including in the Desktop Code tab. Rapid messages no longer leave a session stuck as busy; claude agents status and input notifications are fixed. Esc now takes two presses to clear a prompt, and ctrl+y restores it. In claude attach and claude agents, you must press d within 800 ms after Ctrl+B to move to the background. A background service started without DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING also inherits the value from the session's startup shell. claude rm and the agents view now say a session is "removed from the list" instead of deleting the conversation, and claude --resume still finds it. Split-pane agents verify their team lead and refuse requests once the lead ends; plan approvals must be re-sent after /clear or /resume. Workflow prompts marked by an app as not typed are no longer treated as your request.

items.original:
Fixed a Claude Desktop session getting stuck as busy after another of your sessions sent it the same message twice or many messages at once
Fixed `claude agents` showing a status from an earlier turn after a session resumes
Fixed `claude agents` losing a typed prompt: Esc now needs a second press to clear it, and ctrl+y restores it
Fixed the move-to-background key doing nothing in `claude attach` and `claude agents` sessions; to detach with Ctrl+B d, press d within 800 ms of Ctrl+B
Fixed background sessions ignoring a `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING` set only in your shell when the background service started without it
Fixed false "needs input" notifications in `claude agents` after replying to a blocked session, and repeated ones after a background turn ended with no text and only basic tools such as Bash or Read
Changed how many messages each of your sessions on the same machine can send the others without a prompt from you, from about 20 to 100,000
Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 20 to 100,000
Changed `claude rm` and the agents view to say a session is removed from the list, not deleted; `claude rm` help says the conversation is kept and `claude --resume` lists it
Changed split-pane agent teammates to check that requests come from their team lead: one that outlives its lead has its asks refused, and plan approvals must be re-sent after `/clear` or `/resume`
Changed workflows so that a prompt an app marks as not typed no longer reaches their agents as your request

title.zh-TW: 使用點數不足提供操作選單，Fable 週限制顯示重設時間
title.en: Options Menu for Low Usage Credits and Fable Weekly Reset Times

body.zh-TW: 模型要求付費點數時，你可以先選怎麼繼續。使用點數（另行付費資源）關閉或耗盡會提供停止、改用點數、升級選單。Fable 週限制補重設時間與選單，-p、SDK、IDE、雲端也說明續跑方式。超過週限後，小模型旁支請求不再讓點數通知重複或漏掉。等待請求被拒會重開選單，現有支出上限讀取失敗不再提供較低上限。/usage 對 setup token（設定用令牌）、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 保留工作階段與每週條，解釋其餘缺漏；修正子代理旁百分比，時數只計有請求時段。Desktop 第三方供應商工作階段支援受控設定 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL，須等 Desktop 納入此版才生效。桌面 Code 分頁工作流程遇上限暫停、重設後續跑。
body.en: When a model requires paid credits, you can choose how to continue first. When usage credits (separately billed resources) are turned off or used up, a menu offers stop, switch to usage credits, or upgrade. Fable's weekly limit adds a reset time and options menu, and -p, SDK, IDE, and cloud sessions also explain how to continue. Past the weekly limit, quick side requests on smaller models no longer cause credit notices to repeat or go missing. A refused wait request now reopens the menu, and failing to load your current spend limit no longer offers a lower limit. For setup tokens (credentials used for configuration) and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, /usage keeps the session and weekly bars and explains why the rest are missing; the percentage beside a subagent is fixed, and hours only count periods with requests. Desktop sessions on third-party providers support CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL in managed settings, taking effect once Desktop includes this version. Workflows in the desktop app's Code tab pause at a limit and continue after it resets.

items.original:
Added support for `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version)
Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up
Fixed auto mode running behind a gateway at `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` on a model whose gateway name contains "haiku"; such a model, other than `claude-haiku-5-5`, is now refused, as Haiku 4.5 is
Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice repeating or not showing past the weekly Fable limit when Claude Code made a quick side request on a smaller model, such as naming the session
Fixed Fable's weekly limit showing no reset time and no options menu in the terminal
Fixed a wait chosen in the usage limit menu silently moving to a later reset when its request was refused; the menu now opens
Fixed the spend limit menu offering a lower limit when your current limit couldn't be loaded
Fixed `/usage` hiding limit bars for setup tokens and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`: it keeps the session and weekly bars and says why the rest are missing
Fixed `/usage` showing a whole-session percentage beside a subagent type's name, and saying sessions ran 8 hours when it only counts hours with requests
Improved the Fable limit message in `-p`, SDK, IDE and cloud sessions: it now says when the limit resets, along with how to continue
Changed workflows in the desktop app's Code tab to pause at a usage limit and continue after it resets
Changed the spend limit and 1M context errors, and `/usage-credits`, in cloud sessions and under Remote Control: they no longer give a web address

title.zh-TW: 未知模型容量假設改為 1M，調高過載重試變數的可設上限
title.en: Assumed Context for Unknown Models Raised to 1M, Higher Retry Delay Cap

body.zh-TW: 連接自訂模型時，容量估計不等於實際容量。未知模型上下文視窗（單次能處理的對話容量）假設從 200K 改 1M；可用 /autocompact 提早壓縮，或設 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 留在 200K。第三方小容量模型的工作階段須先設，裝滿可能每輪失敗直到 /clear。claude -p 改用其他模型會向 stderr 警告；不再每次執行印 deniedModels 與 availableModels 註記。/model 恢復最新模型的醒目標示。CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS 上限由 64000 改 300000 毫秒。
body.en: When connecting a custom model, an estimated capacity is not the same as its actual capacity. The assumed context window (conversation capacity handled in a single pass) for unknown models changes from 200K to 1M; use /autocompact to compact earlier, or set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 to stay at 200K. Sessions on third-party models with smaller capacities must set this beforehand, as filling up may fail every turn until /clear. claude -p warns on stderr when switching to another model; it no longer prints deniedModels and availableModels notes on every run. /model restores the highlight on the newest model. The maximum for CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS increases from 64000 to 300000 ms.

items.original:
Fixed Claude being told that automatic model switching is off when safeguards stopped a subagent whose model had no other model to switch to
Fixed the fullscreen header naming the session's effort level for a viewed subagent on a different model, which that subagent doesn't use
Fixed the model picker and `/model` showing a picked effort level that `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` overrides
Fixed the newest model's highlight missing from the `/model` picker
Fixed `claude -p` silently using another model in text output when settings block the requested one; it now warns on stderr
Fixed `claude -p` printing notes about `deniedModels` and `availableModels` entries on every run; `/status` and `claude doctor` still list them
Improved the Claude apps gateway's `/v1/models` to state `max_input_tokens` for models whose context window is certain on every upstream
Changed the context window assumed for a model ID that Claude Code doesn't recognize from 200K to 1M; use `/autocompact` to compact earlier, or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` to keep 200K
Changed sessions on other vendors' models with a smaller window: once full, they can fail every turn until `/clear`, so set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` before they fill
Changed the maximum of `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` from 64000 to 300000
Changed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` in Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to stop applying to auto-memory extraction and, in some sessions, to `/btw`; the main conversation still follows it

title.zh-TW: 終端機排版與按鍵邏輯修復，強化字元渲染與報讀體驗
title.en: Terminal Layout and Keybinding Fixes Improve Rendering and Screen Readers

body.zh-TW: 在終端機連按組合快捷鍵時，動作不可用也不會讓末鍵落進對話輸入欄；拼錯修飾鍵不再誤綁單鍵。重音字換行不再錯位、殘留或消失，長提示不擠掉狀態列。/btw 不帶舊回覆；代理名稱不再被標籤遮住。報讀不受時鐘前跳打斷，也不漏聽寫、貼上與表情符號。無法開瀏覽器時，/upgrade、Ctrl 點連結會顯示網址。丹麥、挪威、法羅、希臘鍵盤輸入 ø 或希臘字母時，不再誤提示 Option。/stickers 改說貼紙領完，不開網頁。Terminal.app 首次設定在同意前說明 Use Option as Meta key、會失去哪些 Option 輸入及如何還原。subagentStatusLine 移除，舊檔仍載入，代理列用預設外觀。
body.en: In the terminal, pressing a key chord no longer sends its last key to the dialog input field when the action is unavailable; misspelled modifiers no longer bind the bare key. Accented characters no longer shift, leave stale copies, or disappear when wrapping, and long prompts no longer push the status line off screen. /btw no longer includes earlier replies; agent names are no longer hidden by labels. Screen reader mode is no longer cut off when the clock moves forward, nor does it drop dictated text, pasted text, or emoji. When no browser can open, /upgrade and Ctrl-clicked links display the address. Typing ø or Greek letters on Danish, Norwegian, Faroese, and Greek keyboards no longer triggers a false Option-key hint. /stickers now says the sticker pack is all claimed instead of opening a web page. First-run setup in Terminal.app explains Use Option as Meta key, which Option inputs stop working, and how to undo it before you agree. subagentStatusLine is removed; old files still load, and subagent rows use the default look.

items.original:
Added a `/diff to close` hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the `?` shortcut guide
Fixed accents and other combining marks sometimes landing left of the text, leaving stale copies on screen, or silently disappearing when text wraps
Fixed the last key of a key chord, such as Enter in ctrl+x enter, acting on a dialog's text field when the chord's own action isn't available there
Fixed `/diff` waiting for Claude to finish before closing the diff panel in fullscreen
Fixed a collapsed tool call looking as if it ran after you rejected it with a reason: it now shows "Not run · rejected"
Fixed a multi-row status line being pushed off screen by a long prompt in the fullscreen renderer
Fixed a misspelled keybinding modifier, such as `ctl+k`, binding the bare key; the binding is now ignored
Fixed `/btw` answers and recaps sometimes including earlier replies from the conversation
Fixed screen reader mode cutting off an announcement when the system clock moved forward while it was being read
Fixed screen reader mode dropping dictated or pasted text, and emoji, typed into an answer to a question or permission prompt
Fixed the name label under permission and plan dialogs hiding part of some agent names
Fixed `/upgrade` and Ctrl+clicked links in fullscreen failing silently when no browser can open: the address is now shown
Fixed terminal control sequences in a subagent's message taking effect instead of showing as plain text when the message is expanded
Fixed the Option-key hint appearing while typing ø or π inside words on Danish, Norwegian, Faroese and Greek keyboard layouts
Changed `/stickers` to say that the sticker pack is all claimed for now, instead of opening a page in the browser
Changed first-run setup in Terminal.app to name the "Use Option as Meta key" setting, what Option stops typing, and how to undo it before you agree
Removed the `subagentStatusLine` setting: subagent rows always use the default look, and settings files that still hold the key load as before

title.zh-TW: 大型檔案編輯與記憶體防護修復，排解裝置檔案卡頓
title.en: Large File Edits and Memory Protections Fixed, Resolving Device Hangs

body.zh-TW: 讀特殊檔案時，特定 /proc 耗盡記憶體、裝置與具名管道卡住的問題已修。非串流請求遇到圖片遭拒或思考區塊錯誤時不再直接失敗。--no-session-persistence 的長工具結果於退出或中斷時清除。存設定記憶體不足不再妨礙啟動與登出清理。Docs 文件可在終端機中開啟瀏覽器；啟動時會重讀改寫中的受控設定。/memory 路徑與預覽開錯成品已修。Pro 與 Max 不再提供組織拒用的回饋草稿。工作樹建立提示補回 .claude 設定。Windows 路徑解析失敗不再誤報目錄遭刪。Linux 不再直接查 autofs 的 /home；自動掛載根目錄比 / 下一層更深時，要設 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS。兩檔案間輸入的 /skill 與 @file 不再生效。
body.en: Fixed out-of-memory errors on certain /proc files and hangs on devices and named pipes when reading special files. Non-streamed requests no longer fail outright on rejected images or thinking block errors. Long tool results with --no-session-persistence are removed on exit or interrupt. Out-of-memory errors when saving settings no longer block startup or sign-out cleanup. Docs documents can open in your browser from a terminal; startup re-reads managed settings that are being rewritten. Fixed /memory paths and previews opening the wrong artifact. Pro and Max accounts are no longer offered feedback drafts that their organization would refuse. The worktree creation tip now includes .claude settings. Windows path resolution failures no longer falsely report that a directory was deleted. Linux no longer looks up /home directly on autofs; set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS when the automount root is deeper than one level below /. /skill and @file typed between two files no longer take effect.

items.original:
Added `.docx` support to Artifact tool asset uploads
Added a one-time startup notice naming `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` when Perforce settings are found and the mode is off
Fixed a memory spike at the next prompt after Claude changed a very large file
Fixed a setting saved in a running session undoing a hand edit made to `settings.json` moments earlier; a settings file you delete during a session now stays deleted
Fixed Edit and Bash running out of memory on certain `/proc` files, and Edit hanging or running out of memory on devices and named pipes
Fixed Claude Code failing to start, or to clear stored credentials at sign-out, when saving its configuration file failed with "Out of memory"
Fixed requests sent without streaming failing on errors that streamed requests recover from, such as a rejected image, thinking block or beta header
Fixed documents created through the Claude Docs connector not opening in your browser when you work in a terminal
Fixed managed settings (`managed-settings.json`, `managed-settings.d`) sometimes being missed at start-up while another program was rewriting the file: start-up now reads such a file a second time
Fixed `.claude/settings.local.json` not being ignored globally when the folder became a git repository later, or on a new machine
Fixed `/memory` showing wrong or roundabout paths for folders whose names start with the working directory's or home folder's name, and losing slashes in the file path on Windows
Fixed a broken emoji character in a tool call's parameter name being resent with later requests, which strict JSON parsers reject
Fixed file titles, app names and session names in @-mentions from claude.ai and the desktop app sometimes being treated as text you typed
Fixed Pro and Max accounts being offered feedback drafts that their organization would refuse
Fixed the artifact preview sometimes opening a different artifact than the one Claude just published
Fixed `--debug` and `--debug-file` replacing a file named `latest` in the debug log's folder
Fixed a timed-out feedback send being reported as too large; it now says the request timed out
Fixed the tip after a slow worktree creation suggesting a `sparsePaths` list without `.claude`, which left worktrees without your project settings and rules
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's JSON logs escaping newlines and other control characters in a message twice
Fixed long tool results staying on disk after a session run with `--no-session-persistence`; they are now removed on normal exit, Ctrl+C or SIGTERM
Windows: Fixed Claude Code running a `.cmd` or `.bat` wrapper found beside a program's `.exe` in the same PATH folder (a `git.cmd` next to `git.exe`, say); it now runs the `.exe`, as `cmd.exe` would
Windows: Fixed shell commands failing with "Working directory was deleted" on drives where a folder's real path can't be resolved
Improved installing with the install script: the latest version is no longer downloaded twice
Improved the `cleanupPeriodDays` cleanup to count folders it can't read as errors
Improved start-up on Linux when `/home` is an autofs map: Claude Code no longer looks up files in `/home` itself. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS` for a map root deeper than one folder below `/`
Changed a `/skill` or `@file` typed between two files picked in claude.ai or the desktop app, or after a picked file and a link, to no longer take effect
Changed worktree creation to refuse checkouts whose `.git` folders are links or hold hard links, such as git-new-workdir layouts and `cp -al` copies; use a plain clone

title.zh-TW: 網頁擷取表格對齊修復，改善巢狀網頁記憶體效能
title.en: WebFetch Table Alignment Fixed and Nested Page Memory Improved

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 抓網頁表格時，空白欄位不再讓後面數值錯位。WebFetch（擷取網頁內容的工具）保留空白儲存格，每次呼叫都重查組織政策與 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH。Chrome 工具會在全螢幕紀錄與子代理進度顯示名稱；互動式 --chrome 工作階段因組織政策未啟用時會說明原因。沒有管理員設定能開啟功能時，不再叫你聯絡管理員；連線提示改叫你用 claude --chrome 重啟。深層巢狀網頁的速度與記憶體使用改善。Chrome 與桌面瀏覽器工具會拒絕部分經跳脫或以 JSON 文字傳入的輸入，並告訴 Claude 如何改寫。⟦資料謄寫員以前跳過對帳單的空格，後面的金額就全擠錯欄；現在照原位留白，讀者不必猜每筆數字屬於哪個欄位。⟧
body.en: When asking Claude to fetch web tables, blank cells no longer shift later values out of alignment. WebFetch (the tool that retrieves web page content) preserves empty cells and rechecks organization policy and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH on every call. Chrome tools now display their names in the fullscreen transcript and subagent progress; interactive --chrome sessions explain when organization policy disables them. When no admin setting can enable the feature, it no longer tells you to contact your admin; the connection prompt now tells you to restart with claude --chrome. Speed and memory use are improved on deeply nested pages. Chrome and desktop browser tools refuse some escaped or JSON-text inputs and tell Claude how to rewrite them. ⟦A ledger clerk used to skip blank spaces on a statement, shifting every later amount into the wrong column; now those blanks stay in place so readers do not have to guess which column each figure belongs to.⟧

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch dropping empty table cells and shifting later values a column left
Fixed WebFetch not rechecking organization policy and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` at each call
Fixed Claude in Chrome's policy message telling people to contact their admin when no admin setting can turn it on
Fixed some Claude in Chrome tool calls, such as `browser_batch`, not showing the tool's name in the fullscreen transcript (ctrl+o) or in a subagent's progress
Fixed an interactive `--chrome` session giving no reason for starting without Claude in Chrome when your organization's policy turns it off: a line now says so
Fixed Claude in Chrome setup saying `/chrome` finishes the connection; it now tells you to restart with `claude --chrome`
Improved WebFetch speed and memory use on deeply nested pages
Changed browser tool calls (Claude in Chrome, the desktop browser pane) to refuse some escaped or JSON-text inputs and tell Claude how to respell them

title.zh-TW: 子代理進度心跳與記憶體釋放，強化遙測匯出容錯
title.en: Subagent Progress Heartbeats, Early Memory Release, and Telemetry Resilience

body.zh-TW: 查子代理紀錄時，壞資料不會拖累整組。OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES 單筆無效仍保留其餘屬性，/status 點名排除項目。SDK managedSettings 的遠端控制、代理檢視、工作流程、產出物四類停用開關恢復生效。OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0 不再記錄背景代理回覆。官方外掛技能啟動自訂代理，agent.name 記為 custom；具名 MCP 匯出依目前連接器目錄調整。MCP 是讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定。子代理壓縮時，相關掛鉤（事件觸發程式）會收到 agent_id、agent_type。防護阻止分支技能或工作流程代理後，可縮小提示重試或告知使用者，不能自行接手工作。完成代理的紀錄也會提早釋放。
body.en: When checking subagent transcripts, one bad entry no longer drags down the whole set. A single invalid OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES entry still keeps the rest of the attributes, and /status names the excluded one. The Remote Control, agent view, Workflows, and Artifact off switches in SDK managedSettings take effect again. OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0 no longer records background agent replies. When an official plugin skill launches a custom agent, agent.name is recorded as custom; named MCP exports follow the current connector directory. MCP is the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools. When a subagent compacts, relevant hooks (event-triggered programs) receive agent_id and agent_type. After safeguards stop a forked skill or workflow agent, Claude can retry with a narrower prompt or tell you instead of taking over the work itself. Transcripts of finished agents are also freed sooner.

items.original:
Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in `claude -p` and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version)
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES` (available since 2.1.318): set it to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries and the requests that write them (anthropics/claude-code#86879)
Fixed a Stop pressed right after sending a message showing as an error in remote and SDK sessions while a `UserPromptSubmit` or plugin prompt hook was still running
Fixed subagent progress summaries skipping an update when the reply took between 10 and 20 seconds
Fixed `PreCompact`, `PostCompact` and post-compaction `SessionStart` hooks not receiving `agent_id` and `agent_type` when a subagent compacts
Fixed the Agent SDK's `managedSettings` ignoring the Remote Control, agent view, Workflows and Artifact off switches
Fixed OpenTelemetry export failing silently when an `otlp` exporter had an endpoint but no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL`: it now defaults to `http/protobuf`
Fixed OpenTelemetry export to the default `localhost:4318` endpoint going through a configured proxy
Fixed one malformed `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` entry dropping all of that variable's attributes from the OpenTelemetry resource; the others are now kept, and `/status` names the one left off
Fixed OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` events and interaction spans recording a background agent's reply when `OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0`
Fixed OpenTelemetry exports failing when a proxy took over 10 seconds to reach the collector; it now has 25 seconds, also the most that `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` can allow (previously 30)
Fixed OpenTelemetry `agent.name` showing a user-defined subagent's name instead of `custom` when an official plugin's skill launched it
Improved memory use with many subagents: a finished subagent's transcript is freed sooner instead of staying in memory while later subagents run
Improved `ToolSearch` to say when a tool Claude searched for by its short name is already available, instead of only reporting no match
Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a forked skill or a workflow agent: retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself
Changed which MCP servers are reported by name in OpenTelemetry exports to follow the current connector directory

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段重啟容錯，確保排程任務與核准狀態延續
title.en: Cloud Session Restart Resilience Keeps Schedules and Approvals Intact

body.zh-TW: 雲端任務重啟後，剛回覆的內容不該消失。歷史重寫後主機立刻停止不再讓紀錄讀不了；長對話重啟不丟答案或未答訊息。/clear、/resume、/branch 不再打斷已結束工作階段的排程。雲端、自架執行器、SDK 重啟後收到計畫核准，不再誤報不在規劃模式。附圖提檔名不再誤報缺圖；恢復時收到檔案不再意外呼叫模型；容器半途關閉不漏中段文字，Cowork 技能首傳也修好。自架按需執行器的工單被取代時，退出代碼恢復為 1；2.1.321、2.1.322 曾改成 0。自架工作階段等連接器核准或工具內登入時，到閒置或存活時間上限會暫停；晚到回覆從全新 clone（複製的儲存庫）恢復。雲端排程中，使用者自身設定的 PostToolUse 掛鉤不能替換 ExitPlanMode 結果中的計畫。
body.en: After a cloud task restarts, recent replies should not disappear. Stopping the machine right after history is rewritten no longer makes transcripts unreadable; restarts in long conversations no longer drop answers or unanswered messages. /clear, /resume, and /branch no longer interrupt scheduled tasks from an ended session. Plan approvals arriving after a restart in cloud, self-hosted runner, and SDK sessions no longer falsely report not being in plan mode. Naming an attached image's file no longer falsely reports it missing; receiving files on resume no longer triggers an unexpected model call; container shutdowns partway through no longer drop middle text, and first-try Cowork skill uploads are fixed. When a self-hosted on-demand runner's work order is superseded, the exit code reverts to 1; 2.1.321 and 2.1.322 had changed it to 0. Self-hosted sessions waiting on a connector approval or in-tool sign-in pause at the idle or lifetime limit; late replies resume from a fresh clone (copied repository). In cloud scheduled tasks, a PostToolUse hook from your own settings can no longer replace the plan in ExitPlanMode's result.

items.original:
Fixed a cloud session's history becoming unreadable if its machine stopped just after the history was rewritten
Fixed scheduled tasks from an ended session sometimes not running after another session in the same folder used `/clear`, `/resume` or `/branch`
Fixed an approved plan being answered with "You are not in plan mode" when the approval arrived after the session's process had restarted, in cloud, self-hosted runner and SDK sessions
Cloud sessions: Fixed an answer to Claude's question being lost after a restart in a long conversation
Fixed a message dropping out of a cloud session's conversation when the session restarted before Claude replied
Cloud sessions: Fixed Claude saying an attached image is missing when the message names its file
Fixed a resumed cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when files arrived right after a chat's first reply
Fixed streamed replies in cloud sessions missing text from the middle when the session's container shut down partway through a reply
Fixed skill files sent from Cowork cloud sessions sometimes failing to upload on the first try
Self-hosted runner: Reverted the exit code of an on-demand runner whose work order was superseded to 1; 2.1.321 and 2.1.322 had changed it to 0
Self-hosted runner: Changed a session at a connector's approval prompt or sign-in inside a running tool to be released as paused at the idle or lifetime limit; a late answer resumes from a fresh clone
Changed cloud scheduled tasks: a `PostToolUse` hook from your own settings can no longer replace the plan in `ExitPlanMode`'s result

title.zh-TW: [Remote Control] 遠端控制網路切換重連，身分保留延長至 30 天
title.en: [Remote Control] Network Reconnects and 30-Day Identity Retention

body.zh-TW: 手機查看工作時，斷線狀態應說清楚。換 Wi-Fi 或重連 VPN 後不再離線逾一分鐘；使用點數問題也顯示在手機，僅終端機能答的提示不再標成執行中。同目錄重啟超過四小時也不換電腦身分，最長保留 30 天。磁碟卡住時，關閉後仍執行、完成工作占名額與啟動失敗拖住主機皆修復。設 DISABLE_TELEMETRY、DO_NOT_TRACK，手機仍顯示核准細節；背景子代理執行不誤報閒置。verbose／debug（詳細／除錯）模式工具 command 是數字、布林值或物件，不再使主機退出或停止讀輸出。電腦在 Claude 啟動前斷線，清單顯示錯誤或閒置；斷線不再誤報環境被刪。執行工作階段的電腦登出 Claude Code 時，錯誤畫面提供 Try again 按鈕。
body.en: When checking work on your phone, disconnection states should be clear. Switching Wi-Fi or reconnecting a VPN no longer leaves sessions disconnected for over a minute; usage credit prompts also appear on your phone, and terminal-only prompts are no longer marked as running. Restarting in the same folder after more than 4 hours no longer changes the computer's identity, which is kept for up to 30 days. When the disk stops responding, sessions left running after shutdown, finished jobs holding slots, and startup failures stalling the host are all fixed. With DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK set, your phone still shows permission details; running background subagents no longer falsely report as idle. In verbose or debug mode, a tool command that is a number, boolean, or object no longer causes the host to exit or stop reading output. When the computer disconnects before Claude starts, the list shows an error or idle status; disconnects no longer falsely report that the environment was deleted. When the computer running a session is signed out of Claude Code, the error screen offers a Try again button.

items.original:
Remote Control: Fixed sessions showing as disconnected for a minute or more after a network change such as switching Wi-Fi or reconnecting a VPN
Fixed Remote Control showing nothing while Claude Code asks whether to use usage credits: the question now also shows in the Claude app
Fixed Remote Control showing a session as running while it waited on a permission prompt that can only be answered in the terminal
Remote Control: Fixed `claude remote-control` reconnecting as a new computer when restarted in the same folder more than 4 hours after it stopped; it now keeps its identity for up to 30 days
Remote Control: Fixed sessions left running at shutdown, and finished sessions holding their slot, when the disk stops responding
Remote Control: Fixed other devices and phone notifications not showing what Claude is asking permission for when `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` is set
Remote Control: Fixed the host exiting, or stopping reading a session's output, in verbose or debug mode when a tool call's `command` was a number, boolean or object
Remote Control: Fixed a host that could stall after sessions failed to start in folders on a filesystem that had stopped responding
Remote Control: Fixed sessions from the desktop app showing as idle on your phone while background subagents were still running
[Remote Control] Fixed your own session saying its environment was deleted when you deleted nothing; it now says your computer is no longer connected
[Remote Control] Fixed some sessions still showing as running in the session list after the computer disconnected before Claude started; they now show an error mark or as idle
[Remote Control] Added a Try again button to the error shown when the computer running your session is signed out of Claude Code

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 編輯器整合即時指令輸出，嚴把未受信任資料夾信任
title.en: [VSCode] Live Command Output in Editor and Untrusted Folder Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 改檔時，進度直接看得到。指令卡片下顯示正在執行的 Bash 或 PowerShell 指令輸出。未信任資料夾首次啟動先問；拒絕便不用專案設定與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。使用點數關閉時，點購買不算同意支付 Fable 費用；新對話首則提示前程序重啟不再誤報讀不到歷史。解析失敗的舊回覆不殘留，壓縮後佇列不漏訊息。重載不再重複叫你重啟終端機；貼碼後顯示 Signing in… 直到完成。切模型清除 Fable 上限提示，點數關閉或用完不再誤提。CRLF（文字換行格式）多行編輯可開差異分頁；切工作階段會停錄音。代理憑證錯誤附指引；沙盒開啟時，從網頁載入不自動切分支並說原因。
body.en: When editing files in VS Code, progress is directly visible. Live output from running Bash or PowerShell commands appears under the command card. Untrusted folders prompt on first launch; declining leaves project settings and MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers unused. When usage credits are off, clicking buy no longer counts as agreeing to pay for Fable; a process restart before a new chat's first prompt no longer falsely reports that history could not be loaded. Old replies that failed to parse no longer linger, and queued messages after compaction are no longer missed. Reloading no longer repeatedly asks you to relaunch the terminal; pasting a code shows "Signing in…" until sign-in finishes. Switching models clears the Fable limit notice, and usage credits are no longer mentioned when turned off or used up. Multi-line edits on files with CRLF (line-ending format) open the diff tab; switching sessions stops dictation recording. Proxy certificate errors include instructions; when the sandbox is on, opening a session from the web no longer switches branches automatically and explains why.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Claude Code trust prompt before the first session in a folder you haven't trusted; declining leaves the folder's settings and MCP servers unused
[VSCode] Added the live output of a running Bash or PowerShell command to the chat, under the command's card
[VSCode] Fixed a response that was discarded because its tool call could not be parsed still showing after Claude retried
[VSCode] Fixed a queued message missing from a conversation or fork when it directly followed a compaction summary
[VSCode] Fixed the "Buy usage credits on claude.ai" button counting as agreement to pay for Fable while usage credits were off
[VSCode] Fixed the "extensions want to relaunch the terminal" warning coming back on open terminals after every window reload or restart
[VSCode] Fixed "Couldn't load this conversation's saved history" appearing in a new chat whose Claude process had restarted before the first prompt
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen showing the login choices again after a pasted code; it now shows "Signing in…" until the sign-in finishes
[VSCode] Fixed the "You've hit your Fable limit" line staying in the VS Code and JetBrains panels after you pick another model
[VSCode] Fixed the Fable usage warning in the VS Code and JetBrains panels naming usage credits when they're off or used up
[VSCode] Fixed the diff tab not opening for multi-line edits on files with CRLF line endings
[VSCode] Fixed dictation continuing to record after switching sessions
[VSCode] Improved sign-in errors behind TLS-inspecting proxies: a certificate failure now says what to do, as the terminal does
[VSCode] Changed opening a Claude Code on the web session in a folder where Claude Code's sandbox is on: the extension no longer switches to the session's branch for you, and the dialog says why

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 網頁版加強自動重連，釐清權限與排程狀態
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Stronger auto-reconnect on the web, clearer permission and schedule status

body.zh-TW: 網頁任務卡住時，原因會說清楚。上傳失敗列原因，儲存庫無權限、登入過期或單一登入藏組織可重連 GitHub。自架暫停重開不再卡 Starting、不殘留 Sending／Stop，待答核准也不消失。網路機密新增失敗列各主機與可判斷的原因，提示留到手動關閉。GitHub Enterprise 提取要求更新連回自家伺服器；大型日誌完整下載。iOS 帶儲存庫的新工作階段有專屬分支。斷線自動重連，Try again 不當訊息送出；無輸出五分鐘仍有停止鈕。排程缺必要沙盒會通知失敗；移除儲存庫不轉移觸發器，Save 等重新選好儲存庫。clone、fetch（複製與抓取更新）逾十分鐘不再於尾端中斷。自架可選 No repository；刪工作階段會警告相關排程暫停。
body.en: When web tasks get stuck, the reason is explained clearly. Upload failures list the reason, and when a repository lacks permission, sign-in has expired, or single sign-on hides organizations, you can reconnect GitHub. Reopening a paused self-hosted session no longer gets stuck on Starting or leaves behind Sending/Stop, and pending approval prompts no longer disappear. Failures to add network secrets list each host and any determinable reason, and the notice stays until you dismiss it manually. GitHub Enterprise pull request updates link back to your own server. Large logs download in full. New sessions from iOS with a repository get their own branch. Disconnected sessions reconnect automatically, and Try again is no longer sent as a message. Even after five minutes with no output, the Stop button remains. Scheduled tasks missing a required sandbox send a failure notification. Removing a repository no longer moves its trigger, and Save waits until you pick a new repository. Git clone and fetch (copying and pulling updates) taking over ten minutes no longer cut off at the very end. Self-hosted environments can select No repository, and deleting a session warns if related scheduled tasks will pause.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the message when a file fails to upload to a cloud or Remote Control session: it now gives the reason, such as too many pages, a password or a time-out
[Claude Code on the web] Improved adding a repository Claude can't access to a cloud session: a short message and a Reconnect GitHub button replace the long error
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed self-hosted sessions staying on "Starting Claude Code" after it had started, when you reopened a paused session without sending a message
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a paused session in a self-hosted environment sometimes still showing "Sending" and a Stop button under the "Session paused" banner
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed pull request updates from GitHub Enterprise Server linking to github.com in cloud sessions; new updates link to your own server
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the message when some network secrets can't be added to a new cloud environment: it lists each host, says why where it can, and stays until you dismiss it
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed very large GitHub Actions job logs and run log archives failing to download or being cut off in cloud sessions
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the new-session repository picker when GitHub single sign-on hides organizations: it now says so even with other repositories listed, and links to reconnect GitHub
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions started from the iOS app with a repository not getting a branch of their own
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed an open cloud or Remote Control session's page staying "Disconnected" after a few minutes of failed connections; it now tries to reconnect by itself
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed Try again on an open cloud or Remote Control session's "Connection lost" card sending "Try again" as your message; it now tries to reconnect instead
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed the Stop button disappearing from a cloud session five minutes into a reply that had shown nothing yet while Claude was still working
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed an approval prompt sometimes disappearing from a tab left open after a self-hosted runner released the session while it waited for your answer
[Claude Code on the web] Added a failure notification when a scheduled task's run can't start because its settings require a sandbox that isn't available where it runs
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the Git providers page when your GitHub sign-in has expired: it now asks you to reconnect instead of silently hiding organizations you can link
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed removing a repository from a scheduled task silently moving its GitHub trigger to another repository; Save now waits until you pick one
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed git clones and fetches that take longer than ten minutes in a cloud session sometimes being cut off at the very end
[Claude Code on the web] Added the No repository option to the repository picker for new sessions on a self-hosted environment
[Claude Code on the web] Added a warning to a cloud session's Delete dialog when deleting it will pause scheduled tasks that run in that session

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 整合納入企業合規檢索，細化頻道權限管控
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack integration added to Enterprise compliance search, refining channel permission controls

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 請 Claude 幫忙時，核准卡片不該出現在無法張貼的地方。與 Claude 的私訊中，私人或 Slack Connect 頻道不再顯示核准並張貼卡片，Claude 也會取得不能張貼的原因。企業方案的 Slack 對話納入合規 API（供組織查核紀錄的介面）測試版，可列工作階段與讀紀錄；管理員停用組織 Claude Tag 前會確認並說明影響。跨 Enterprise Grid 工作區的頻道排程可正常呼叫 Slack。頻道設定載入失敗可重試；活動頁的網路事件可依 Scope 篩選下載。移除連接器會移除設在連接器上的憑證（登入證明），保留存取套件自身的憑證。頻道緊接所屬工作區顯示。Set for Claude Tag 連結前往 Slack 頁面的 Advanced 分頁設定環境。
body.en: When asking Claude for help in Slack, approval cards should not appear where Claude cannot post. In DMs with Claude, private or Slack Connect channels no longer show the Approve and post card, and Claude also receives the reason it cannot post. Slack conversations on Enterprise plans are now included in the Compliance API (an interface for organizations to audit records) in beta, letting you list sessions and read transcripts. Before an admin turns off Claude Tag for the organization, a confirmation step explains what stops. Scheduled tasks in channels across Enterprise Grid workspaces can call Slack normally. Channel settings can be retried if they fail to load. Network events on the Activity page can be filtered by Scope for download. Removing a connector removes the credentials (authentication proof) set on the connector while keeping the access bundles' own credentials. Channels appear right under their workspace. The Set for Claude Tag link opens the Slack page's Advanced tab to set the environment.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added Claude Tag sessions started in Slack to the Compliance API on Enterprise plans, in beta: list the sessions and read their transcripts
[Claude Tag] Added a confirmation step when an admin turns off Claude Tag for the organization, with a dialog that says what stops
[Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled tasks in a Slack channel moved between Enterprise Grid workspaces failing to use Slack until someone posted there
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Approve and post card in a DM with Claude appearing for private or Slack Connect channels, where Claude can't post; Claude now gets the reason and shows no card
[Claude Tag] Added a Retry button to a Slack channel's Configure page for when its settings fail to load
[Claude Tag] Added a Scope filter to the Network events tab of Claude Tag's Activity page, so admins can download one scope's events instead of the whole organization's
[Claude Tag] Fixed Remove connector in Claude Tag admin settings being refused when access bundles also held its credentials; it now removes those set on the connector and leaves the bundles' own
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Channels tab in Claude Tag admin settings splitting a workspace from its channels across pages; channels now appear right under their workspace
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Set for Claude Tag link on the Cloud environments admin page not leading to the environment setting; it now opens the Slack page's Advanced tab, where you set it

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 管理後台新增 CSV 匯出，精細統計審查支出成本
title.en: [Code Review] CSV export added to admin settings for detailed review cost tracking

body.zh-TW: 評估團隊內部使用程式碼審查工具的預算消耗時，管理員現在能直接將費用清單匯出為表格。現在 Code Review 管理設定新增了 Download CSV 按鈕，讓你可以依據月份、週次或單日，針對單一儲存庫、特定 GitHub 組織或全體專案，直接下載審查費用的 CSV 報表。⟦就像公司總務月底印出各部門的分攤明細表，以前只能看著整張總帳單發愁，現在能按專案與週期逐筆拆解核對開支。⟧
body.en: When evaluating a team's budget consumption for code review tools, admins can now export the cost list directly as a table. Code Review admin settings now include a Download CSV button, letting you download a CSV report of review costs by month, week, or day for a single repository, a specific GitHub organization, or all projects. ⟦Picture an office manager printing departmental cost-allocation sheets at month-end: instead of staring helplessly at a single lump-sum bill, you can now break down and verify expenses line by line by project and period.⟧

items.original: [Code Review] Added a Download CSV button to Code Review admin settings: export review costs per repository by month, week or day, for one repository, one GitHub organization or all

title.zh-TW: 終端機工作區可開多個旁聊分頁
title.en: Terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs

body.zh-TW:
寫程式寫到一半想另開話題發問，不必擠在同一個對話框裡來回翻找。開啟選用性質的終端機工作區後，你可以在側邊同時建立多個旁聊分頁，直接用鍵盤或滑鼠在分頁間切換。

就算把 Codex 關掉重新啟動，之前留在本機的旁聊紀錄依然能再次打開接著用。⟦就像煮菜備料多擺幾個小碗，以前只能全倒進同一個碗裡混著攪，現在每道菜分開裝，隔餐打開冰箱還能原封不動端出來接著煮。⟧
body.en:
When you want to ask about a separate topic mid-coding, you no longer have to scroll back and forth inside a single chat box. With the opt-in terminal workspace enabled, you can open multiple side-chat tabs along the side and switch between them with your keyboard or mouse.

Even if you quit and restart Codex, you can still reopen saved local side chats and pick up where you left off. ⟦Picture prepping ingredients with several small bowls instead of dumping everything into one bowl to mix together: each dish stays separate, and when you open the fridge for the next meal, you can pull it out intact and keep cooking.⟧

items.original: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)

title.zh-TW: 代理指令中心可依關鍵字搜尋舊任務
title.en: Search older tasks by keyword in agent command center

body.zh-TW:
想找幾天前跑過的那個任務，不用再從清單一路往下慢慢滑。打開代理指令中心後，現在可以直接用任務名稱、提示詞預覽或工作目錄來搜尋較早的任務。

昨天剛處理完一份專案報告、今天想沿用當時的任務紀錄，只要輸入對應的工作目錄或提示詞裡的字句就能找出來。⟦跟去 KTV 點歌一樣，以前得一頁頁翻厚重的歌本找曲目，現在打歌名、歌詞片段或歌手名字就能立刻叫出來。⟧
body.en:
To find a task you ran a few days ago, you no longer have to scroll all the way down a long list. Inside the agent command center, you can now search older tasks by task name, prompt preview, or working directory.

If you finished a project report yesterday and want to reuse that task record today, just type the matching working directory or words from the prompt to pull it up. ⟦Think of picking songs at karaoke: instead of flipping page by page through a thick songbook, you type the title, a lyric snippet, or the artist's name to bring it right up.⟧

items.original: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕紀錄可收合過程只留回答
title.en: Collapse activity in full-screen transcript to keep answers

body.zh-TW:
回頭檢視長長的對話紀錄，最常被中間一大段工具執行過程洗版，想看最終回答得捲好久。現在只要在全螢幕對話紀錄開啟 **Collapse turn details**，每個提問底下已經完成的執行過程就會自動摺疊起來。

摺疊後回答本身依然清楚顯示在畫面上，而收起來的工具輸出內容也還是能直接搜尋。⟦好比逛展看畫作，以前連運送木箱和包裝紙都還堆在畫框底下，現在把打包材料收進儲藏室只留作品本身，真要查物流標籤依然調得到。⟧
body.en:
Reviewing a long transcript often means wading through walls of tool execution steps just to reach the final answer. Now, when you turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript, completed activity beneath each prompt folds away automatically.

Your answers stay clearly visible on screen, while the collapsed tool output remains directly searchable. ⟦A gallery exhibition works the same way: instead of leaving shipping crates and wrapping paper piled under every frame, the packing materials go into storage so only the artwork stays on display, yet you can still look up the shipping labels whenever needed.⟧

items.original: Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)

title.zh-TW: 終端機可管理自訂供應商並用裝置碼登入
title.en: Manage custom providers and sign in with device code in terminal

body.zh-TW:
連進遠端主機或沒有瀏覽器的純文字環境，想接入自訂的模型供應商常卡在無法跳轉網頁登入。現在你可以直接在終端機新增或修改自訂模型供應商。

只要啟用自訂閘道器引導設定，登入過程中就能順手建立供應商。遇到支援的閘道器，就算是在 SSH（遠端文字連線）或沒有本機瀏覽器的機器上，也能改用裝置碼完成驗證。⟦如同在沒有刷卡機的自助寄物櫃前，以前非得帶著實體感應卡才打得開，現在只要螢幕跳出一組取件碼，拿旁邊的手機輸入就能把櫃門連上打開。⟧
body.en:
Connecting to a remote host or a text-only environment without a browser often stalls when a custom model provider expects a web login redirect. You can now add or edit custom model providers directly from the terminal.

With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider right during sign-in. For supported gateways, even over SSH (remote text connection) or on a machine without a local browser, you can authenticate using a device code instead. ⟦Imagine standing at a self-service locker with no card reader: where you once needed a physical tap card, the screen now shows a pickup code that you enter on your phone beside it to open the door.⟧

items.original: Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)

title.zh-TW: 回報編輯器按 Ctrl+S 可本機存診斷檔
title.en: Press Ctrl+S in report editor to save diagnostics locally

body.zh-TW: 公司電腦限制網路或環境停用上傳功能，出狀況卻找不到地方把診斷資料帶出來給人排查。現在只要在終端機回報編輯器按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把診斷用 ZIP 壓縮檔直接存到本機，就算上傳功能被關閉也一樣能存。⟦彷彿在沒有手機訊號的山區寫工作日誌，以前送不出去就只能留在畫面上乾瞪眼，現在按一下存檔鍵就能先存進隨身記憶卡帶下山。⟧
body.en: When a corporate network is restricted or uploads are disabled, getting diagnostic data out for troubleshooting can be a dead end. Now, pressing `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor saves a diagnostic ZIP archive directly to your machine, even when uploads are turned off. ⟦It feels like writing a field log on a mountain with no cell signal: instead of staring at an unsent screen, you hit save to write it onto a portable memory card and carry it down with you.⟧

items.original: Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)

title.zh-TW: 終端機 Cloud 連線支援傳圖與封存對話
title.en: Terminal Cloud connection supports images and archiving

body.zh-TW:
用 macOS 或 Linux 開著終端機連上 Cloud，以前遇到要傳截圖或調整思考深度時，還是得另外找別的介面處理。現在啟用這項選用連線後，直接在終端機就能傳送圖片，也能挑選要用的模型和推理力度。

討論告一段落，或想還原 Cloud 對話時，在終端機同樣可以直接封存或還原 Cloud 對話。⟦比方說智慧手錶原本只能收到文字提醒，現在直接能在錶面上傳照片、調推播強度，還能把舊通知收起來或翻出來。⟧
body.en:
When connected to Cloud from a terminal on macOS or Linux, sending a screenshot or adjusting reasoning depth used to mean switching to another interface. With this opt-in connection enabled, you can now send images and choose your model and reasoning effort directly from the terminal.

Once a discussion wraps up, or when you want to bring back an earlier thread, you can archive or restore Cloud conversations right from the terminal as well. ⟦Say a smartwatch could previously only display text alerts, and now lets you send photos, adjust notification intensity, and tuck away or pull back old alerts straight from your wrist.⟧

items.original: With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

title.zh-TW: 未信任目錄執行 codex exec 不載入設定
title.en: codex exec skips project config in untrusted directories

body.zh-TW:
從網路下載陌生專案準備跑自動檢查，最怕資料夾裡夾帶的設定偷偷啟動外部連線。就算加上 `--sandbox workspace-write`，只要資料夾還沒被信任，`codex exec` 仍會把專案設定和 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器保持停用。

確認目錄安全、想正式儲存信任狀態，可在 `codex exec` 或 `codex review` 加上 `--trust` 參數。⟦拿電腦插上來路不明的隨身碟來說，就算你允許電腦寫入檔案，裡頭附帶的自動執行腳本還是會被鎖住，非得你親手點下信任按鈕才會放行並記住。⟧

```bash
codex exec --trust    # 執行任務並儲存專案信任
codex review --trust  # 進行審查並儲存專案信任
```
body.en:
Running automated checks on an unfamiliar project downloaded from the web always carries the risk of bundled settings silently opening external connections. Even with `--sandbox workspace-write`, `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers disabled as long as the directory is untrusted.

Once you verify the directory is safe and want to save its trusted status, pass `--trust` to `codex exec` or `codex review`. ⟦Plug an unfamiliar USB drive into your computer, and even if you allow writing files to it, its autorun scripts stay locked until you explicitly click trust to let them run and remember your choice.⟧

```bash
codex exec --trust    # Run task and save project trust
codex review --trust  # Run review and save project trust
```

items.original: `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)

title.zh-TW: 清空脈絡開始實作時會完整交接計畫
title.en: Full approved plan handed off when clearing context

body.zh-TW: 跟 Codex 敲定修改方案後，很多人會先清空脈絡重新開局，免得前面討論佔住記憶空間。現在點選 **Yes, clear context and implement**，Codex 會把整份已經核准的計畫完整交給新的工作階段。萬一交接失敗，原本的工作階段仍會保持開啟，不會當場關閉。⟦就跟銀行辦理舊戶結清轉存一樣，一定要確認完整金額已經入到新帳戶，行員才會把舊存摺剪角，要是中途轉帳失敗，原本的戶頭就會原封不動留著。⟧
body.en: After finalizing a plan with Codex, clearing context for a fresh start keeps earlier discussion from eating up memory. Now, selecting **Yes, clear context and implement** hands the full approved plan over to the fresh session. If the handoff fails, the current session stays open instead of closing on the spot. ⟦Like closing an old bank account to transfer the balance, the teller only cancels the old passbook after confirming the full amount has landed in the new account, leaving the original account untouched if the transfer fails midway.⟧

items.original: **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 沙盒路徑與目錄權限問題
title.en: Fix Windows sandbox path and directory permission handling

body.zh-TW: 用 Windows 沙盒跑指令，遇到帶引號的 `cmd.exe` 路徑，或是工作目錄上層無法讀取的 PowerShell 工作階段，過去沙盒處理會出狀況。這個問題已經修好，現在這兩種情況都能正常處理。
body.en: Running commands in the Windows sandbox previously broke on quoted `cmd.exe` paths or PowerShell sessions whose working directory had an unreadable parent. This has been fixed, and both cases now work properly.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)

title.zh-TW: macOS 貼上圖片保留方向與原生格式
title.en: Preserve orientation and native format for pasted macOS images

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 複製圖片直接貼進對話框，過去偶爾會碰到照片方向歪掉的困擾。現在貼上的圖片會保留原本預期的方向。只要剪貼簿裡有原生的 PNG 或 JPEG 資料，也會直接採用這些格式。
body.en: Copying and pasting an image directly into the chat box on macOS could occasionally leave the photo rotated the wrong way. Pasted images now retain their intended orientation. Whenever native PNG or JPEG data is available on the clipboard, those formats are used directly as well.

items.original: Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再卡在等待或被前輪中斷波及
title.en: Terminal no longer gets stuck waiting or hit by prior interruptions

body.zh-TW:
在終端機跑完或喊停一輪對話，最怕上一輪的等待或殘留訊號卡住接下來的新操作。

面對共用應用伺服器沒有回報的 MCP 伺服器，終端機現在不會再一直停在忙碌狀態苦等。

被打斷的對話回合也會乾淨收尾；就算前面遲來的中止訊號或檔案核准取消比較晚才到，也不會再打斷後面的回合。⟦有如攝影棚接連拍兩組客人，上一組提前收工就得把現場清乾淨，沒送到的器材或遲來的取消通知才不會打亂下一組開拍。⟧
body.en:
After finishing or stopping a conversation turn in the terminal, the last thing you want is waiting or leftover signals from the previous round blocking your next step.

When a shared app server does not report back on MCP servers, the terminal no longer stays stuck in a busy state waiting.

Interrupted turns also wrap up cleanly, so even a late abort signal or a delayed file approval cancellation will no longer cut off a later turn. ⟦Just as a photo studio shooting two clients back-to-back must clear the set when the first wraps early, undelivered gear or late cancellation notices will not disrupt the next shoot.⟧

items.original:
The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

title.zh-TW: openai-docs 技能聚焦團隊設定與上手
title.en: openai-docs skill focuses on team setup and onboarding

body.zh-TW: 剛上手想搞懂 Codex 與 ChatGPT Work，或是第一次串接 API（程式對接介面）不知從何起步，都可以直接找 `openai-docs` 技能幫忙。更新後的 `openai-docs` 把重心放在這兩項產品的疑問與首次 API 設定，還加入在團隊中統一配置 Codex 的專門指南。⟦像把綜合手冊換成城市專區摺頁一樣，第一次怎麼搭車、熱門疑問跟團體帶隊須知全集中在同一份裡。⟧
body.en: If you are just getting started with Codex and ChatGPT Work, or unsure where to begin with your first API (an interface for connecting programs) integration, you can turn straight to the `openai-docs` skill. The updated `openai-docs` focuses on questions about these two products and first-time API setup, and adds dedicated guidance for configuring Codex consistently across a team. ⟦Swapping a general handbook for a city-specific brochure puts first-time transit tips, popular questions, and group-leader notes all in one place.⟧

items.original: Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器客戶端補齊模型與閘道器文件
title.en: App-server clients get docs for models and gateways

body.zh-TW: 給正在開發串接程式的工程師：想針對個別已設定的供應商做操作，卻不想動到原本的預設選項，可以參考這次的說明。文件裡現在清楚說明，如何在不改動預設供應商的前提下，替已設定好的供應商列出模型，或是替它的閘道器完成授權。
body.en: For engineers building integrations who want to target a specific configured provider without touching the default option, this update has you covered. The documentation now clearly explains how to list models for a configured provider or authorize its gateway without changing the default provider.

items.original: Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819)

title.zh-TW: 內建 SQLite 升級 3.54 納入日誌修復
title.en: Bundled SQLite upgraded to 3.54 with log fixes

body.zh-TW: Codex 背後靠內建的 SQLite 資料庫把資料存進本機，平時大多數人不會直接操作它。這次將內建的 SQLite 更新到 3.54 版，納入預寫式日誌（資料正式寫入前先留底的機制）的相關修復。⟦跟寄包裹前先把寄件單留底一樣，這次更新把這道預先記一筆的程序毛病修好，在背後平穩執行。⟧
body.en: Under the hood, Codex relies on a bundled SQLite database to store data locally, though most people never interact with it directly. This update upgrades bundled SQLite to version 3.54 and pulls in fixes for the write-ahead log (a mechanism that keeps a backup record before data is officially saved). ⟦Much like keeping a copy of the shipping slip before sending a package, this update fixes a glitch in that pre-recording step so it runs smoothly behind the scenes.⟧

items.original: Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集升級可沿用本機資料省下載
title.en: Plugin marketplace upgrades reuse local data to cut downloads

body.zh-TW: 在外掛市集進行升級，最煩的就是明明電腦裡已經存過很多檔案，卻還是得再從網路抓一次。現在外掛市集升級可以直接沿用硬碟上既有的 Git（版本控制工具）資料物件，減少重複下載。⟦拿拼樂高換新版造型來比喻，以前每次改版都整盒積木重新買一套，現在發現桶子裡本來就有的零件可以直接拿來組，不必全都重買。⟧
body.en: When upgrading in the plugin marketplace, few things are more annoying than having to download files all over again when plenty of them are already on your computer. Plugin marketplace upgrades can now reuse existing Git (a version control tool) objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. ⟦Take rebuilding a LEGO set into a new model: instead of buying a whole new box every time, you can use parts you already have in the bin and skip buying everything again.⟧

items.original: Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. (#60528)

title.zh-TW: 挑好新對話的模型供應商，舊對話依然照原設定跑
title.en: Pick a Model Provider for New Chats While Existing Ones Keep Theirs

body.zh-TW: 想替接下來的新工作換成另一家 AI 模型供應商（提供 AI 運算的服務商），現在可以在工作階段選單的「Sessions → Model providers」直接瀏覽清單並指定新對話的預設值。⟦就像幫手機換了預設撥號門號一樣，往後新撥的電話都會走新方案，原本正講到一半或重新接通的通話，則依然留在原本的線路上。⟧你更動新對話的預設選項後，目前開著的視窗與恢復接續的舊對話，都還是會使用各自原本儲存的模型供應商。當你手邊正有一個不想換模型的進行中專案，想讓之後開的新對話改跑別家服務時，就能放心在「Sessions → Model providers」調整預設。
body.en: If you want to switch upcoming work to a different AI model provider (a service that supplies AI computing), you can now browse the list under "Sessions → Model providers" in the sessions menu and set the default for new chats. ⟦Like switching the default dialing line on a phone, future calls go through the new plan, while calls already in progress or reconnected stay on the original line.⟧ After you change the default for new chats, open windows and resumed chats still use their own saved model provider. When you have an active project that should stay on its current model while future chats use another service, you can adjust the default under "Sessions → Model providers" without disrupting it.

items.original:
Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats. (#59541, #59722)
Open and resumed chats use their saved model provider after you change the default for new chats. (#59503)

title.zh-TW: 開啟工作區窗格並排顯示側邊對話
title.en: Enable Workspace Panes to View a Side Chat Beside the Main One

body.zh-TW:
寫主要專案寫到一半想另外查資料，卻不想切走眼前這個畫面時，這個設定就能派上用場。啟用 `features.tui_workspace` 後，就能在主對話旁並排顯示側邊對話。

開啟後，你可以直接拖曳中間的分隔線來調整兩個窗格（畫面裡分割出來的獨立區塊）的大小，或是按下 `leader z` 快捷鍵把目前聚焦的窗格放大查看。⟦試想原本一次只能攤開一本書的桌面，現在擺上活動隔板就能並排對照兩本筆記，推拉隔板即可調寬窄，想專心看哪本也能單獨拉近放大。⟧當你在主對話修改簡報大綱，想順便開個側邊對話查資料又不想切換頁面時，拉寬窗格即可對照，看完再按 `leader z` 放大回主畫面。
body.en:
When you are partway through a main project and want to look something up without switching away from the current screen, this setting comes in handy. Enabling `features.tui_workspace` lets you display a side conversation beside the main chat.

Once enabled, you can drag the center divider to resize the two panes (separate sections split within the screen), or press the `leader z` shortcut to zoom in on the focused pane. ⟦Picture a desk that used to hold only one open book at a time: adding a movable divider lets you compare two notebooks side by side, sliding the divider adjusts their widths, and you can pull either one closer to focus.⟧ When you are editing a presentation outline in the main chat and want to open a side chat to look things up without switching views, widen the pane to compare them and press `leader z` afterward to zoom back to the main screen.

items.original: Enable `features.tui_workspace` to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press `leader z` to zoom the focused pane. (#58992, #59527, #59595)

title.zh-TW: 支援音訊模型直接夾帶錄音檔對話
title.en: Attach Recordings Directly in Chats with Audio-Capable Models

body.zh-TW: 開完會手邊留著幾段語音筆記，想直接請 AI 幫忙聽並整理重點時，現在可以省下不少功夫。只要選用支援音訊的模型，就能在 Codex 裡夾帶錄音檔一起對話。傳送過程中，已經確定被模型拒收的錄音檔，Codex 在後續幾輪對話會自動跳過不再重複送出。Codex 也會依據每段錄音的長度來計算佔用空間，讓比較多段短錄音能留在上下文（AI 當前記得住的對話內容範圍）裡。⟦好比剪輯師整理桌上的錄音帶，確認被退件的帶子會直接挑到一旁不再送審，短片段則按各自長度緊湊排進桌面，手邊就能多留幾段備用。⟧當你把好幾則簡短的語音備忘錄分批交給支援音訊的模型整理時，既不用擔心無效檔案一再重傳，短錄音也能更多段一起保留在對話脈絡中。
body.en: If you have voice notes left after a meeting and want the AI to listen and summarize key points directly, this saves a lot of effort. As long as you choose an audio-capable model, you can attach recordings in Codex chats. During sending, Codex automatically skips recordings that the model has confirmed rejecting on later turns instead of resending them. Codex also calculates space usage based on each clip's duration, allowing more short recordings to stay in context (the range of conversation content the AI currently remembers). ⟦Think of an editor sorting audio tapes on a desk: rejected reels are set aside so they are never resubmitted, while short clips are packed tightly by length to keep more of them on hand.⟧ When you send several short voice memos in batches to an audio-capable model, invalid files will not keep resending, and more short clips can remain in the conversation context together.

items.original: Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context. (#59234, #59268)

title.zh-TW: 設定可啟用動態 GIF 圖片生成與編輯
title.en: Enable Animated GIF Generation and Editing via Config

body.zh-TW:
做簡報或回訊息時，有時用一張靜態圖很難講清楚操作步驟，這時候一段會動的示意圖就很有用。啟用 `features.image_generation_animation` 後，就能請 Codex 生成或編輯動態 GIF 圖片。

生成或修改動畫時，你還可以視需要調整影格數量（組成動畫的連續畫面張數）與時間節奏控制。⟦彷彿從單張插畫變成手翻書，以前只能產出一張靜止圖片，現在能自己決定畫幾頁以及每頁停留的節奏，整串連起來就會動。⟧當你需要製作一個示範動圖或調整既有 GIF 的播放節奏時，就能用上這項設定。
body.en:
When making slides or replying to messages, a single static image sometimes cannot explain steps clearly, and a moving visual helps. Enabling `features.image_generation_animation` lets you ask Codex to generate or edit animated GIFs.

When generating or modifying an animation, you can also adjust the frame count (the number of sequential images that make up the animation) and timing controls as needed. ⟦You move from a single illustration to a flipbook, where instead of producing one static picture, you decide how many pages to draw and how long each stays on screen so the sequence comes alive.⟧ Whenever you need to create a demo animation or tweak the playback pacing of an existing GIF, this setting covers it.

items.original: Enable `features.image_generation_animation` to generate or edit animated GIFs with optional frame count and timing controls. (#59073)

title.zh-TW: tmux 全螢幕模式可透過 Ghostty 與 Kitty 顯示圖片與寵物
title.en: Fullscreen tmux Displays Images and Pets on Ghostty and Kitty

body.zh-TW: 習慣把 Codex 放進全螢幕使用的人，如果在終端機裡還套了一層管理視窗，現在終於不用放棄看圖。只要你使用的是 Ghostty 或 Kitty 這兩款終端機，並在 tmux（終端機多工管理工具）裡開啟 `allow-passthrough all` 設定，全螢幕下的 Codex 就能正常顯示圖片預覽與寵物。⟦打開這項轉送功能就像拉開雙層玻璃之間的遮簾，以前多隔一層容器時圖片和寵物會被擋在內側，開通後影像才能透到最外層畫面。⟧當你開著 tmux 工作、想邊做事邊查看圖片預覽或看著螢幕上的寵物時，加上 `allow-passthrough all` 就能把畫面完整呈現在全螢幕裡。
body.en: If you like running Codex in fullscreen inside an extra terminal management layer, you no longer have to give up viewing images. As long as you use Ghostty or Kitty and enable `allow-passthrough all` in tmux (a terminal multiplexer tool), fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets properly. ⟦Turning on this passthrough works like opening the blinds between double-pane glass: previously an extra container layer blocked images and pets on the inside, and opening the path lets them show through to the outer screen.⟧ When you are working in tmux and want to check image previews or keep an eye on pets on screen, adding `allow-passthrough all` renders everything cleanly in fullscreen.

items.original: Fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets in tmux on Ghostty and Kitty with `allow-passthrough all`. (#59579, #59580)

title.zh-TW: 終端機通知支援 osc777 協定並拉長指令預覽
title.en: Terminal Notifications Support osc777 with Longer Command Previews

body.zh-TW:
切換到別的視窗處理事情、等 Codex 回報進度或請示授權時，可以在設定檔將終端機通知設為 `tui.notification_method = "osc777"`，其中 `osc777` 是一種讓終端機發送桌面通知的協定。

需要你放行的核准通知也會變得更清楚。通知裡會顯示更長的指令預覽，並且明確區分究竟是等待終端機輸入，還是請求網路存取。⟦跟汽車中控螢幕一樣，以前儀表板只會亮一顆籠統的警示燈，現在會直接寫明狀況類別，連多一點細節也一併攤在螢幕上。⟧當你專心回信、突然跳出確認通知時，不用切回原本視窗就能先看清指令內容與請求類型，判斷要不要授權。
body.en:
When you switch to another window while waiting for Codex to report progress or request approval, you can set terminal notifications in your config to `tui.notification_method = "osc777"`, where `osc777` is a protocol that lets the terminal send desktop notifications.

Approval notifications that need your go-ahead are also clearer. They show longer command previews and clearly distinguish between waiting for terminal input and requesting network access. ⟦A car's center display works similarly: the dashboard used to light up only a generic warning icon, whereas now it spells out the exact category and puts more details on screen.⟧ When a confirmation alert pops up while you are focused on writing an email, you can see the command details and request type right away to decide whether to approve without switching back.

items.original: Set `tui.notification_method = "osc777"` for terminal notifications. Approval notifications show longer command previews and distinguish terminal input from network access requests. (#59256)

title.zh-TW: 本機歷史與恢復清單依登入帳號篩選新對話
title.en: Local History and Resume Lists Filter New Chats by Account

body.zh-TW: 輪流在同一台電腦登入不同 ChatGPT 帳號的人，要接續先前的進度時最在意各帳號紀錄不混雜。現在本機 TUI（終端機文字介面）的歷史紀錄與恢復對話選擇器，會依據目前登入的 ChatGPT 帳號來篩選新建立的對話串。⟦如同共用電腦裡的個人工作資料夾，以前新建紀錄要自己分辨歸屬，現在會依登入者篩選；換帳號時，新紀錄的篩選依據也跟著換。⟧你之後切換回個人或公司帳號想繼續之前的進度時，打開歷史或恢復對話清單，其中新建立的對話串會依目前登入的 ChatGPT 帳號篩選。
body.en: For anyone switching between different ChatGPT accounts on the same computer, keeping each account's records separate matters most when picking up where you left off. Local TUI (terminal text interface) history and resume pickers now filter newly created threads by the currently signed-in ChatGPT account. ⟦Imagine personal work folders on a shared computer: previously you had to sort out which new records belonged to whom, whereas now they are filtered by who is signed in, and switching accounts switches the filter too.⟧ Later, when you switch back to your personal or work account to continue earlier work, opening the history or resume list filters newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account.

items.original: Local TUI history and resume pickers filter newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account. (#58918)

title.zh-TW: 被工具中斷的回覆合併顯示並還原推理摘要
title.en: Tool-Interrupted Replies Merge Together with Reasoning Summaries Restored

body.zh-TW: 當你回頭檢視先前的對話過程，最怕看到一篇回覆被插進來的工具呼叫切得支離破碎。現在 TUI 介面遇到回覆中途被工具呼叫打斷的情況時，會把整段回答合併顯示成單一則 Markdown（一種用簡單符號排版標題與清單的純文字格式）訊息。重播過去的對話紀錄時，畫面也會把當初的推理摘要（AI 整理出來的思考過程重點）重新還原出來。⟦宛如把講到一半去翻資料的演講稿重新排成一篇完整文章，事後回顧紀錄時，當初附在旁邊的思考重點筆記也會跟著回到原位。⟧當你需要回頭檢查 Codex 之前怎麼一步步得出結論時，整段回答與推理摘要都會連貫地呈現在畫面上。
body.en: When you review an earlier conversation, nothing is worse than seeing a single reply chopped into pieces by mid-turn tool calls. Now, when a reply is interrupted by tool calls in the TUI, the interface merges the whole answer into a single Markdown (a plain-text format that uses simple symbols to style headings and lists) message. When replaying past conversations, the screen also restores the original reasoning summaries (highlights of the thinking process organized by the AI). ⟦Suppose a speaker pauses mid-talk to check notes, and you typeset the transcript back into one continuous article with the margin notes restored beside it when reviewing later.⟧ Whenever you need to trace how Codex reached a conclusion step by step, the full reply and reasoning summaries appear as a continuous whole on screen.

items.original: The TUI renders replies interrupted by tool calls as a single Markdown message and restores reasoning summaries when replaying a conversation. (#59698, #59700)

title.zh-TW: 長跑對話與存檔空檔也能接住引導訊息
title.en: Long-Running Chats and Save Windows Still Catch Steering Messages

body.zh-TW: 任務跑到一半突然想補一句話調整方向，有時剛好會撞上對話收尾或你剛切回視窗的瞬間。現在這種臨時插話的引導訊息（在回合還沒結束時送出、用來修正方向的補充指令），即使剛好在最後儲存對話紀錄的期間送出，或是你暫時切到別處再回到一個跑了很久的對話後才發送，都能順利送達正在執行的回合。⟦猶如列車正準備進站收尾、或你剛走回車廂拿起對講機，駕駛室的通訊頻道依然暢通，臨時送出的改道提醒仍舊接得上。⟧以後看到 Codex 正在長跑、突然想補上修正方向，就算剛切回對話視窗也能馬上送出。
body.en: When a task is halfway through and you want to add a quick note to adjust direction, it can sometimes collide with the conversation wrapping up or the moment you switch back to the window. Now, steering messages (supplemental instructions sent before a turn finishes to adjust direction) still reach the running turn even if sent during the final transcript save or after you switch away and return to a long-running chat. ⟦Even as a train pulls into the station or you walk back into a carriage with a radio, the cab's channel stays open so last-minute rerouting cues still get through.⟧ From now on, if Codex is in a long run and you want to nudge its direction, you can send it right away even if you just switched back to the chat window.

items.original: Steering messages reach running turns when sent during the final transcript save or after switching back to a long-running chat. (#58877, #58998)

title.zh-TW: 模糊搜尋提高檔名吻合的排序比重
title.en: Fuzzy Search Gives Filename Matches More Weight

body.zh-TW: 專案資料夾層數越積越多，輸入幾個字找檔案卻老是被上層目錄的名字搶走前排位置，往往得往下翻好幾行。現在模糊檔案搜尋（只輸入片段字元就能比對路徑的搜尋功能）提高了檔名吻合的排序比重，讓吻合上層資料夾名稱的項目比較不會把目標檔案擠掉。⟦正如在大型倉儲按品名找貨物，以前只要某條走道的區域名稱剛好撞字，整排雜貨就會搶佔前幾行，現在會把箱子本身名稱吻合的先排出來。⟧下次你想快速叫出某個檔案、卻碰巧它的父資料夾名字也帶有相同字詞時，搜尋結果會更容易把你要的檔名留在前排。
body.en: As project folders grow deeper, typing a few characters to find a file often lets parent directory names steal the top spots, forcing you to scroll down several lines. Now, fuzzy file search (a search feature that matches paths using only partial characters) gives filename matches more weight so items matching parent folder names are less likely to crowd out your target file. ⟦Consider searching for goods by item name in a large warehouse: previously a matching aisle name let a whole row of unrelated items crowd the top, whereas now boxes whose own labels match are listed first.⟧ Next time you want to pull up a file quickly and its parent folder happens to share the same word, the search results will more easily keep the filename you want near the top.

items.original: Fuzzy file search gives filename matches more weight so matching parent directories are less likely to crowd them out. (#59709)

title.zh-TW: Windows 閒置本機 MCP 伺服器讓出檔案讀寫通道
title.en: Idle local MCP servers on Windows free up file read and write channels

body.zh-TW: 在電腦背景掛著幾個備用的外接小工具時，就算當下沒用到它們，你也希望其他功能照常運作。現在 Windows 上處於閒置狀態的本機 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，會把資源讓出來。檔案系統 I/O（檔案的讀取與寫入作業）會維持開放，供 Codex 的其餘部分使用。⟦設想共享車道上停著沒在動工的貨車卻曾佔住通行空間，現在只要它停在閒置狀態就會空出車道，讓其餘車輛照常搬運貨物。⟧即使背景還掛著暫時沒在運作的本機工具，Codex 其餘功能依然能順暢處理檔案讀寫。
body.en: When you have a few spare add-on tools running in the background on your computer, you still want everything else to work normally even when you are not using them. Now idle local MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers on Windows yield those resources. Filesystem I/O (file reading and writing operations) stays available to the rest of Codex. ⟦Parked delivery trucks on a shared lane used to block traffic while sitting idle, but now they clear the lane whenever they are not working so other vehicles can keep hauling cargo.⟧ Even with inactive local tools sitting in the background, the rest of Codex can still handle file reads and writes smoothly.

items.original: Idle local MCP servers on Windows leave filesystem I/O available to the rest of Codex. (#59726)

title.zh-TW: app-server 參考文件補齊供應商與雲端閘道設定
title.en: app-server reference adds provider and cloud gateway settings

body.zh-TW: 要把 Codex 串進團隊自己的後端服務或雲端模型時，查閱開發指引是最快上手的方式。現在 app-server（應用程式伺服器，負責在背景處理請求的核心服務）的參考文件，已經涵蓋如何列出模型供應商與建立自訂閘道器。這份文件也說明了如何更新閘道器（統一轉送連線請求的入口）、AWS 的 Bedrock 與 Google 雲端平台 GCP 的設定。⟦比方說買回音響設備時附上一張完整接線圖，從有哪些音源可選、怎麼接自訂轉接盒，到後續怎麼調各家通道參數都寫得清清楚楚。⟧以後團隊要串接 Bedrock 或 GCP 雲端環境，或架設內部模型閘道器時，照著這份參考文件就能直接查到對應做法。
body.en: When connecting Codex to your team's own backend services or cloud models, checking the developer guide is the fastest way to get started. The reference documentation for app-server (the core background service that handles requests) now covers how to list model providers and create custom gateways. It also explains how to update settings for gateways (unified entry points that forward connection requests), AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud's GCP. ⟦Buying new audio gear now comes with a complete wiring diagram that clearly shows which sound sources you can pick, how to hook up a custom adapter box, and how to adjust each channel's settings later.⟧ Going forward, teams connecting to Bedrock or GCP cloud environments, or setting up an internal model gateway, can look up the exact steps directly in this reference.

items.original: The app-server reference covers listing model providers, creating custom gateways, and updating gateway, Bedrock, and GCP settings. (#58845, #58876)

title.zh-TW: 明確設定 features.multi_agent 時提示改用 agents.enabled
title.en: Warning points to agents.enabled when features.multi_agent is explicitly set

body.zh-TW:
曾在設定檔裡寫過 `features.multi_agent` 的人，可能會在畫面上看到一則提醒。只要設定檔裡明確寫了 `features.multi_agent`，Codex 現在就會跳出警告，並指引你想關閉 subagent（分頭幫主代理處理工作的小幫手）工具時要改用 `agents.enabled`。

⟦有如路口多了一張提醒牌，以前照原本的路牌設定路線，現在仍照那塊牌子走時，就會看到提示，告訴你要關閉這條通道該看另一塊路牌。⟧下次看到這個警告時，可依提示查看用來停用子代理工具的 `agents.enabled` 設定。
body.en:
Anyone who has written `features.multi_agent` in their config file may see a reminder on screen. Whenever `features.multi_agent` is explicitly set in the config file, Codex now shows a warning pointing you to `agents.enabled` if you want to turn off subagent (small helpers that handle work for the main assistant) tools.

⟦At a junction where a new sign has been posted, anyone who previously set their route by the old sign and still follows it now sees a notice telling them to check the other sign to close that lane.⟧ The next time you see this warning, you can follow the prompt and check the `agents.enabled` setting used to disable subagent tools.

items.original: Codex warns when `features.multi_agent` is explicitly configured and points to `agents.enabled` for disabling subagent tools. (#59479)

title.zh-TW: 免 BuildBuddy 憑證即可在本機跑 Bazel 測試
title.en: Run Bazel tests locally without BuildBuddy credentials
