body.zh-TW: 在多個儲存庫之間切換開發時，手動調整的設定若無聲無息失效，往往會引發意想不到的混亂。如果權限規則無法載入，例如語法解析錯誤或 `.claude/settings.json` 不是合法的 JSON 格式，現在開啟工作階段時會立刻跳出警告通知，不再默默略過。在 `/hooks` 停用某個專案的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）時，修改範圍僅限於當前儲存庫，不會連帶停用其他專案裡的同名掛鉤。在 Skills 分頁開關個別技能時，只會將 `[skills].disabled` 項目儲存至 `config.toml`，由組織統一派送的技能資料夾與忽略清單會持續維持套用。以前規則寫錯常讓人摸不著頭緒，停用專案工具還會意外波及其他工作區；現在問題即時提醒，各專案的外掛設定也互不干擾。
body.en: When switching development across multiple repositories, manual settings that fail silently often cause unexpected confusion. If permission rules fail to load, such as when syntax does not parse or `.claude/settings.json` is not valid JSON, a warning notification now appears immediately when opening a session instead of being silently skipped. Disabling a project hook in `/hooks` applies only to the current repository, without disabling hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) of the same name in other repositories. Turning an individual skill on or off in the Skills tab saves only `[skills].disabled` to `config.toml`, so managed skill folders and ignore lists distributed by an organization keep applying. Previously, misconfigured rules were baffling and disabling a project tool could inadvertently affect other workspaces; now issues surface immediately and plugin settings for each project remain isolated.

items.original:
Permission rules that do not load, such as a rule that does not parse or a `.claude/settings.json` that is not valid JSON, show a warning when a session opens instead of being skipped silently
Disabling a project's hook in `/hooks` applies only to that repository, instead of also skipping hooks with the same name in other repositories
Turning a skill on or off in the Skills tab saves only `[skills].disabled` to `config.toml`, so an organization's managed skill folders and ignore list keep applying

title.zh-TW: 儀表板掌握背景代理動態，隨時中斷任務且按鈕支援懸停高亮
title.en: Dashboard tracks background agents, stops runs anytime, and highlights controls on hover

body.zh-TW: 指派背景代理同時處理多項任務時，能即時掌握真實進度並隨時喊停至關重要。⟦宛如操作中央監控台的調度員，螢幕上只會標明真正運轉中的機具數量，按下急停開關也能瞬間切斷作業，不必等巡檢單確認完畢。⟧工作流程狀態列現在會明確顯示「仍有多少代理正在執行」，而不是列出代理的建立總數。當背景任務跳出等待授權的確認卡片時，只要點擊工作列（dock，停靠在畫面邊緣的操作列）上的停止按鈕，就能立刻中止該背景執行，不必先被迫回答卡片。若工作階段仍有背景子代理或工作流程在跑，儀表板的清單項目會持續停留在「工作中」狀態，在此處停止該列也能徹底結束所有關聯任務。提問卡片的確認送出按鈕、儀表板彈出視窗的關閉鍵與摺疊的工作流程列，在滑鼠游標移過時也都會高亮醒目顯示。
body.en: When assigning background agents to handle multiple tasks at once, tracking real progress in real time and being able to halt runs at any moment is essential. ⟦Picture a dispatcher at a central monitoring console: the screens display only equipment actively running, and hitting an emergency stop cuts operations instantly without waiting to clear inspection slips.⟧ Workflow status lines now clearly say how many agents are still running instead of listing the total number created. When an approval card pops up for a background task, clicking the stop button in the dock (an action bar pinned along the screen edge) stops that background run immediately instead of forcing you to answer the card first. Dashboard rows stay in Working while a session has background subagents or workflow runs going, and stopping the row there completely ends all related tasks. A question card's `Enter:submit` button, the dashboard session popup's `[✗]`, and collapsed workflow rows also highlight prominently when hovered by the mouse pointer.

items.original:
Workflow status lines say how many agents are still running instead of how many exist
Stop buttons in the dock stop a background run while its approval card is open, instead of doing nothing until you answer the card
A question card's `Enter:submit` button, the dashboard session popup's `[✗]`, and collapsed workflow rows highlight under the mouse pointer like other clickable controls
Dashboard rows stay in Working while a session's background subagents or workflow runs are going, and stopping the row ends them

title.zh-TW: 拒絕變更保留手動存檔，不再覆寫你自己修改的內容
title.en: Rejecting changes preserves manual saves, preventing your own edits from being overwritten

body.zh-TW: 趁著模型產生程式碼的空檔順手修補檔案，最擔心的就是退回建議時自己的心血被一併沖掉。⟦恰似請裝潢師傅在設計圖紙上標記草案，就算你最後否決了他的整套改建構想，你自己先前用色筆畫上的插座標記依然完整保留。⟧以前若 Grok 漏偵測到你手動存檔，拒絕變更時就會覆寫你已儲存的修改。現在即使 Grok 漏偵測到存檔事件，當你選擇拒絕變更時，檔案中所有由你親自儲存的修改都會被完整保留下來。
body.en: Tinkering with files while waiting for a model to generate code comes with the worry that rejecting a suggestion will wipe away your own work. ⟦Think of asking a contractor to sketch proposals onto a blueprint: even if you reject the remodeling concept altogether, the outlet marks you penciled in beforehand remain intact.⟧ Previously, if Grok missed detecting a manual save, rejecting a change would overwrite the edits you had already stored. Now, even when Grok misses a save event, choosing to reject a change keeps all edits you saved to the file yourself completely intact.

items.original: Rejecting a change keeps edits you saved to the file yourself, even when Grok missed the save, instead of overwriting them

title.zh-TW: 匯出至無程式讀取的具名管道立即報錯，背景寫入時刪除不再報「Directory not empty」
title.en: Exporting to unread named pipes fails immediately, and deleting sessions during background writes avoids "Directory not empty"

body.zh-TW: 跨目錄恢復歷史工作階段或將對話匯出到管線，以往常因資料夾路徑與背景寫入而受阻。⟦跟翻閱隨身索引夾一樣，無論你在哪一個工作桌前翻開標籤，都能直接指引回當初存放卷宗的特定抽屜。⟧現在無論你從哪一個目錄啟動終端機，執行 `grok --resume <id>` 都會自動切換至當初記錄該工作階段（session，工作期間的對話與狀態紀錄）的資料夾開啟，不再直接報錯拒絕。當使用 `/export` 將對話匯出至沒有任何程式正在讀取的具名管道（讓程式經由特定路徑傳送資料的通道）時，Grok 會立即回報失敗，不再凍結到只能強制終止行程。執行 `grok sessions delete` 清理歷史紀錄時，即使其他背景行程仍在向該工作階段資料夾寫入資料，也不會再因「Directory not empty」錯誤而中斷。
body.en: Resuming past sessions across directories or piping conversations outward was often blocked by folder paths and background writes. ⟦Much like flipping through a portable index binder, opening a tab from any desk leads straight back to the specific drawer where the dossier was originally filed.⟧ Now, wherever you launch your terminal from, running `grok --resume <id>` automatically switches to open in the folder where the session (records of conversation and state during work) was recorded, instead of refusing outright. When using `/export` to send a conversation to a named pipe (a channel that passes data between programs via a file path) that nothing is reading, Grok fails right away instead of freezing until killed. When cleaning up history with `grok sessions delete`, it no longer fails with "Directory not empty" even while other background processes are still writing into that session folder.

items.original:
`grok --resume <id>` opens the session in the folder it was recorded in, wherever you launch Grok from, instead of refusing
`/export` to a named pipe that nothing is reading fails right away instead of freezing Grok until it is killed
`grok sessions delete` no longer fails with "Directory not empty" when another process is still writing into the session's folder

title.zh-TW: 提示詞支援首尾跳轉與選取，捲動歷史鍵入字元自動聚焦
title.en: Prompts support boundary jumps and selection, while typing in scrollback auto-focuses

body.zh-TW: 編輯長篇提示詞或翻閱歷史訊息時，頻繁切換游標與輸入焦點往往打斷思路。現在按 `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` 或 `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` 可直達提示詞首尾，加按 `Shift` 能從目前游標選到提示詞開頭或結尾。在空白提示詞按 `Left` 鍵，從任何工作階段或歡迎畫面都能開啟儀表板。捲動歷史中按 `Ctrl+L` 可將選取的整則訊息或反白文字轉成引文填入提示詞，擴充套件改以 `/plugins` 開啟。捲動歷史取得焦點且未開啟 vim 鍵（用字母鍵移動與編輯文字的模式）時，鍵入數字或符號現在會跟字母一樣，移回提示詞並輸入；`?` 仍開啟指令區。當 `Ctrl+Enter` 被接收成一般 `Enter` 時，頁尾送出提示會顯示 `Enter Enter`，預設設定的 tmux（終端機分割工具）就是例子。
body.en: When editing lengthy prompts or reviewing message history, constantly switching cursor and input focus often interrupts your train of thought. Pressing `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` or `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` now jumps directly to the start or end of the prompt, and adding `Shift` selects from the current cursor to the prompt start or end. Pressing `Left` on an empty prompt opens the dashboard from any session or welcome screen. In scrollback, pressing `Ctrl+L` adds a selected message or highlighted text to the prompt as a quote, while extensions now open via `/plugins` instead. Typing a digit or symbol while scrollback has focus, with vim keys (a mode using letter keys for navigation and editing) turned off, moves focus to the prompt and types it there, just as letters already do; `?` still opens the command palette. When `Ctrl+Enter` arrives as plain `Enter`, the footer send indicator displays `Enter Enter`, with tmux (a terminal multiplexer) under default settings being one example.

items.original:
`Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` and `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` move the cursor to the start or end of the whole prompt, and with `Shift` they select to there
Send now shows as `Enter Enter` in the footer where `Ctrl+Enter` arrives as plain `Enter`, such as inside tmux with its default settings
`Left` on an empty prompt opens the dashboard from any session or the welcome screen, not only from a session you opened from the dashboard
`Ctrl+L` in the scrollback adds the selected message or highlighted text to the prompt as a quote; open Extensions with `/plugins` instead
Typing a digit or symbol while the scrollback has focus, with vim keys off, moves focus to the prompt and types it there, as letters already do; `?` still opens the command palette

title.zh-TW: 狹小終端機介面自適應精簡，特殊字元與舊版主控台不再破圖
title.en: Compact terminals adaptively streamline UI, while special characters and legacy consoles display cleanly

body.zh-TW: 將視窗縮小或在舊版主控台操作時，擠成一團的文字與缺字方框往往讓人難以閱讀。在狹窄畫面中，頁尾與狀態列會自動精簡項目，防止按鈕重疊或被截斷。在高度不足的終端機開啟倒回（rewind，將對話復原至先前步驟）確認視窗，或在該確認視窗開著時縮小終端機，Grok 不再當機。emoji（表情符號）與按鍵符號精確依終端機實際寬度計算，列不再超出框線，也不再遺失列尾的 `…`。生成媒體路徑包含中日文字元或 Windows 格式時，檔名也能完整保留並貼合欄寬。在 Windows 舊版主控台（如 cmd.exe 與 PowerShell），清單列的符號改用相容字元，不再出現破圖空方框。16 色終端機則將貼上標籤與工具強調色改為其他次要文字使用的柔和灰，淺色主題下貼上標籤的括號也不再消失。
body.en: Shrinking windows or operating in legacy consoles often makes crowded text and missing character glyphs painful to read. In narrow screens, footer and status bars automatically drop or shorten items, preventing buttons from overlapping or being cut off. Opening a rewind (restoring a conversation to an earlier step) confirmation dialog on a short terminal, or shrinking the terminal while that window remains open, no longer crashes Grok. Emoji and keycap symbols are measured precisely to the terminal's actual rendering width, so rows no longer overflow their borders or lose their trailing `…`. When generated media paths contain Chinese or Japanese characters or Windows formats, file names remain intact and fit row widths. On older Windows consoles such as `cmd.exe` and PowerShell, symbols in list rows use compatible characters instead of rendering as broken empty boxes. Terminals with 16 colors display paste labels and tool accents in the muted gray used by other secondary text, and paste label brackets no longer vanish under the light theme.

items.original:
Windows: on older consoles such as plain `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell windows, the `▶`, `⏸` and `◌` marks in todo, workflow and list rows show as characters the console can draw instead of empty boxes
Generated image and video paths with wide characters such as Chinese, Japanese or emoji fit their row and keep the file name, and Windows paths keep it too
The rewind confirmation no longer crashes Grok on a short terminal or when you shrink the window while it is open
Footer and status bars in narrow terminals drop or shorten the items that do not fit, instead of painting them over each other or cutting buttons off
16-color terminals show the paste label and tool accents in the muted gray other secondary text uses, and the paste label brackets no longer vanish on the light theme
Emoji and keycap symbols are measured at the width the terminal draws them, so rows no longer run past their box or lose their `…`

title.zh-TW: 工具輸出截斷對齊程式碼規格，引文排版與排隊筆記顯示更完整
title.en: Tool output truncation aligns with code cells, while quote layout and queued notes display fully

body.zh-TW: 閱讀引文對話或檢查工具回傳的長文字時，清楚規整的排版能幫你迅速掌握關鍵細節。當 Fetch、網路搜尋或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的輸出過長被截斷時，底部會顯示如同程式碼單元的提示列，標明剩餘行數與展開按鍵。只隱藏一行時會顯示 `+1 line`。在排隊提示詞上方顯示的模型切換結果或就緒工作樹（worktree，讓專案平行開副本的功能），當提示詞開始執行時會持續保留在螢幕上，不再被捲出視野。在對話引文方面，引文內的程式碼區塊每一行都會整齊收在引用線下方，複製引文時參照連結會自動轉為行內連結，多行數學公式後的行號也標記正確。若點擊了當前環境無法開啟的連結或本機檔案，例如在無桌面畫面的遠端連線下，介面會明確顯示原因，不再毫無動靜。
body.en: Clear and disciplined formatting helps you quickly grasp key details when reading quoted dialogue or inspecting lengthy tool output. When output from Fetch, Web Search, or MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) is cut off, the bottom displays an indicator row matching code cells to show remaining lines and your viewer key. A single hidden line reads `+1 line`. Notes above a queued prompt showing a model switch result or a ready worktree (a feature enabling parallel working copies for a project) stay on screen when execution starts, instead of scrolling out of view. Inside conversation quotes, every line of a code block stays neatly beneath the quote bars, copying a quote turns reference links into inline links, and lines following multi-line math are numbered correctly. Clicking a link or local file that cannot open in the current environment, such as over an SSH connection with no display, clearly explains why instead of doing nothing.

items.original:
Clicking a link or file that cannot open, such as over SSH with no display, shows why, for example "Can't open links over SSH"
Notes above a queued prompt, such as a model switch result or a ready worktree, stay on screen when the prompt starts instead of scrolling out of view
Cut-off Fetch, Web Search and MCP tool output ends with the same `… +N lines · <key> to view all` row as code cells, naming your viewer key, and one hidden line reads `+1 line`
Code blocks inside quotes render every line under the quote's bars, quote copies turn reference links into inline links, and lines after multi-line math are numbered correctly

title.zh-TW: 目標與驗證提醒預設不再單獨存下檢查紀錄
title.en: Goal and verify reminders no longer save separate check logs by default

items.original:
Sessions take less disk space: the goal reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.goal-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`
Sessions take less disk space: the verify reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.verify-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷
title.en: Models that cannot view images no longer break when reading images

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告
title.en: Agent sessions in editors warn when they can no longer be saved

body.zh-TW: 你跟 AI 互動到一半，如果這段紀錄沒辦法繼續存下來，以前不會收到任何提示。現在只要工作階段無法再存檔，編輯器就會發出警告。
body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: muse exec 的 JSON 附圖也會加編號
title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.zh-TW: 過去執行 `muse exec --json --image` 帶入圖片，提示詞裡不會幫圖片加上編號。現在它會比照不加 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image`，在提示裡為每張附圖標上 `[Image #N]`。
body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.

items.original: `muse exec --json --image` now labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt, as `muse exec --image` without `--json` already does

title.zh-TW: 短句開頭的非英文回答不再被丟棄重寫
title.en: Non-English answers after a short opening message are no longer discarded and rewritten

body.zh-TW:
第一則訊息只打幾個字，原本會讓法文、西班牙文、德文等外語回覆整個作廢重來。現在這些非英文回答都會留住。Muse 只會在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你主動要求用英文時，才會把工作階段語言設成英文。

⟦好比手機自動切換輸入法，以前開頭打太短就會把剛寫好的外語整段刪掉換成英文，現在除非出現常見英文詞或你主動要求，否則不會擅自換語言。⟧
body.en:
Typing just a few words in your first message used to cause replies in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages to be discarded and rewritten. Now those non-English answers are kept. Muse only sets the session language to English when your messages use common English words or when you ask for English.

⟦Picture a phone that auto-switches keyboards: previously, a short opening message would wipe out the foreign-language text you just wrote and replace it with English, whereas now it will not switch languages on its own unless common English words appear or you ask for it.⟧

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 壓縮完的工作階段不再回頭重讀全部紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read their entire log

body.zh-TW: 工作階段剛做完壓縮，以前還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄從頭再讀過。現在壓縮結束後，這項背景重讀已經取消。
body.en: Right after a session compacted, it used to re-read the entire session log from the beginning in the background. Now, once compaction finishes, that background re-read has been canceled.

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

title.zh-TW: Agent 遇阻回報與建置除錯流程改進
title.en: Improved Agent Blocker Reporting and Build Debugging

body.zh-TW:
跑開發任務遇到網路被擋、分支落後或要填表單，Muse 的應對順序都改了。

只要網路政策擋下某步驟需要的下載，它會在執行其他步驟前立刻問你，不再改試其他來源或拖到最後報告才寫。

若你手上的分支進度落後且建置失敗，它會改在最新分支上建置與測試。失敗輸出裡若有提到修法，它也會持續處理，直到套用或提供修法給你。

操作瀏覽器應用程式的表單時，現在會直接依你的點擊回傳結果，不再等背景步驟跑完。⟦就像拿文件去影印店卻遇上紙張規格被限制，店員不再自己換別種紙試印或最後才講，而是立刻停下來問你。⟧
body.en:
When development tasks run into a blocked network, a behind branch, or a form, Muse now responds in a different order.

Whenever a network policy blocks a download that a step needs, it asks you right away before running other steps, instead of trying other sources or waiting until the final report to mention it.

If your branch is behind and its build fails, it builds and tests on the up-to-date branch instead. If the failure output mentions a fix, it also keeps working until that fix is applied or offered to you.

When interacting with browser app forms, they now return results directly from your click instead of waiting for a background step to finish. ⟦Picture bringing documents to a copy shop and running into a paper-size restriction: instead of trying a different paper on their own or telling you only at the end, the clerk stops and asks you right away.⟧

items.original: Muse asks you right away, before the other steps, when a network policy refuses a download a step needs, instead of probing other sources or naming the block only in its final report, builds and tests on the up-to-date branch when your checkout is behind and its build fails, keeps working until a fix the failure output names is applied or offered, and makes browser app forms return their result from your own click instead of waiting on a background step

title.zh-TW: Agent 改動環境設定與常駐服務前會先詢問
title.en: Agent Asks Before Changing Environment Settings or Background Services

body.zh-TW:
你請 Muse 寫完一個小工具，它卻沒打招呼就把指令裝進電腦路徑裡，這最讓人頭痛。現在只要你沒主動要求，它在執行這幾件事前都會先停下來問你。

這包括把剛建置好的程式放進 `PATH` 環境路徑、取代或蓋過既有的同名指令、編輯終端機殼層啟動檔，以及安裝背景服務。⟦好比去剪頭髮時，設計師如果想幫你換洗髮精或加做護髮，一定先問過你點頭，不會沒交代就自己動手。⟧
body.en:
Having Muse finish a small tool and install the command into your computer's path without asking is frustrating. Now, unless you explicitly asked for it, Muse stops and asks you before doing any of the following.

This includes putting a newly built program on your `PATH`, replacing or shadowing an existing command with the same name, editing shell startup files, or installing a background service. ⟦Think of getting a haircut: if the stylist wants to switch your shampoo or add a conditioning treatment, they always ask for your nod first rather than doing it without telling you.⟧

items.original: The agent asks before changes you did not request: putting what it built on your PATH, replacing or shadowing a command already there, editing shell start-up files, or installing a background service

title.zh-TW: 開發瀏覽器遊戲會依你指定的技術堆疊製作
title.en: Browser Games Follow Your Specified Tech Stack

body.zh-TW: 想在瀏覽器裡做小遊戲並指定特定技術框架，以前不管你怎麼要求，Muse 總是一律做成純 HTML 檔案。現在只要在要求裡寫明想用的技術堆疊，它就會照你的指定去實作。
body.en: When you wanted to build a small browser game with a specific framework, Muse used to always make plain HTML files no matter what you asked for. Now, as long as you name the tech stack you want in your request, it implements the game using what you specified.

items.original: Browser games follow the stack the request names instead of always using plain HTML files

title.zh-TW: 檢查內容報告會將草稿專用項目獨立列出
title.en: Content Check Reports List Draft-Only Items Separately

body.zh-TW:
請 Agent 做一份區分已發布與未發布內容的檢查報告，過去那些只出現在草稿裡的素材很容易被誤標成沒人用，甚至整筆漏寫。

現在 Agent 在回報完成前會被要求重跑這份檢查，並把只給未發布內容使用的項目獨立列在草稿專屬標題下，不再說成未使用或漏掉。
body.en:
When you ask the Agent for a check report that separates published from unpublished content, assets that only appear in drafts used to be easily mislabeled as unused or left out altogether.

Now, before reporting that it is done, the Agent is prompted to rerun the check and list items used only by unpublished content under a dedicated draft-only heading, instead of calling them unused or leaving them out.

items.original: When you ask for a checker or report that separates published from unpublished content, the agent is now prompted to rerun it and list items used only by unpublished content under their own draft-only heading, instead of calling them unused or leaving them out, before saying it is done

title.zh-TW: 長對話防塞爆模型容量並提示開新工作階段
title.en: Long Conversations Prevent Overflow and Suggest Starting a New Session

body.zh-TW:
跟 AI 聊得太長、累積了滿滿的歷史訊息，最怕一按送出就跳出請求過大的錯誤。

只要模型的上下文視窗（單次對話能容納的總量上限）大小已知，Muse 送出提問時會先把要求回覆的字數縮到剩餘空間裝得下的範圍，擋掉長對話常見的請求過大錯誤。

萬一那一輪的內容依然超過模型的容量上限，錯誤提示現在也會直接告訴你可以改開一個新的工作階段。⟦如同往快裝滿的後車廂塞東西，先縮減待會要放進去的紙箱大小；真的完全塞不下了，就直接換一輛空車來載。⟧
body.en:
When a chat with AI grows long and piles up history, hitting send only to get a request-too-large error is the last thing you want.

Whenever a model's context window (the total amount a single conversation can hold) is known, Muse trims the requested reply length to fit the remaining room before sending your prompt, preventing common request-too-large errors in long chats.

If that turn's content still exceeds the model's capacity limit, the error message now tells you directly that you can start a new session instead. ⟦It is like packing an almost-full trunk: you first shrink the size of the box going in next, and if it still cannot fit at all, you simply switch to an empty car.⟧

items.original:
When a turn does not fit the model's context window, the message now says you can start a new session
A turn on a model with a known context window now trims the output it asks for to the room the window has left, which prevents most request-too-large errors in long conversations

title.zh-TW: 阻擋 /goal 摘要夾帶隱藏終端機控制碼
title.en: Block Hidden Terminal Control Codes in /goal Summaries

body.zh-TW:
用 `/goal` 追蹤任務時，過去模型產生的文字可能會把視窗標題改掉、清空螢幕或亂移游標。

這項安全問題已經修好，現在 `/goal` 摘要印出前會先濾掉看不見的終端機控制字元，摘要中的模型文字不再能改變終端機標題、清空畫面或移動游標。⟦拿佈告欄上的便條紙來說，以前上頭藏的隱形記號會讓人誤改看板標題，現在先抹掉記號後它就只是純文字告示。⟧
body.en:
When tracking tasks with `/goal`, model-generated text could previously change the window title, clear the screen, or move the cursor.

This security issue is fixed: invisible terminal control characters are now stripped before the `/goal` summary prints, so model text in the summary can no longer alter the terminal title, clear the screen, or move the cursor. ⟦Take a sticky note on a bulletin board: hidden marks on it used to trick someone into changing the board's title, but wiping those marks off first leaves it as a plain-text notice.⟧

items.original: Security: The `/goal` summary no longer lets goal text written by the model change the terminal title, clear the screen, or move the cursor; invisible terminal control characters are removed before the summary prints

title.zh-TW: 跨機對話與失敗工作流程需先更新再接續
title.en: Update Before Resuming Cross-Machine Chats and Failed Workflows

body.zh-TW:
在不同裝置上混用新舊版本的 Muse，接續紀錄時要特別留意相容性。

只要新版曾經連線或嘗試連線到別台機器執行指令，舊版就開不了這筆對話。若在舊版用編號或工作階段挑選器開啟它，舊版可能會自己另開本機對話，讀舊紀錄後直接在這台電腦接手。因為任務內容原本可能是給別台機器跑的，重開前請先更新程式，其餘對話不受影響。

舊版也無法接續曾留下狀態檢查失敗紀錄的工作流程，一樣要先更新應用程式才能恢復。⟦跟用舊導航機讀新路線一樣，讀不懂跨區標記時它可能會擅自就近重排一趟行程，想避免跑錯環境就得先升級程式。⟧
body.en:
When mixing older and newer versions of Muse across different devices, watch out for compatibility when resuming chats.

If a newer build connected or tried to connect to another machine to run commands, an older build cannot open that chat. If you open it in an older build by ID or through the session picker, the older build may start a new local chat on its own, read the old log, and continue the work right on this computer. Because that work may have been meant for the other machine, update the app before reopening the chat; other chats are unaffected.

Older app versions also cannot resume a workflow that recorded a failed status check, so you must update the app to resume it as well. ⟦Like an old GPS reading a new route, it might reroute a local trip on its own when it cannot understand cross-region markers, so upgrading first keeps you from running in the wrong place.⟧

items.original:
A Muse build older than this release cannot open a chat that a newer build connected, or tried to connect, to another machine to run commands there. When such a chat is resumed by id or chosen in the session picker, that build may instead start a new local chat on its own that reads the old chat's log and continues the work on this machine; update the app before reopening the chat, because that work may have been written for the other machine. Other chats are unaffected
Older app versions can't resume a workflow that recorded a failed status check; update the app to resume it

title.zh-TW: 修正接續舊工作階段失敗與選單錯位問題
title.en: Fix Session Resume Failures and Picker Selection Issues

body.zh-TW:
把做到一半的工作階段重新叫出來接續，以前從挑選清單到載入狀態常出狀況，現在這些斷點都修好了。

接續失敗重回挑選器時，清單列出剛才那筆後會直接選中它，按 Enter 不會再誤開別筆。

需轉進新工作階段接續時，就算最新檢查點寫在回合之間也不會失敗，對話內容都會留著。

壓縮並重開工作階段後，存好的工作流程仍可繼續接續。

用 `--resume`、`--continue` 或 `/resume` 重開時，若子代理（分擔子任務的獨立代理）狀態讀不到，展開紀錄不再重複顯示它。

前輪存設定失敗、下輪沿用相同規則或指示時，重開工作階段不再失敗。

分岔工作階段若在記下工作區前就先執行，下次接續會補認該工作區，挑選器也會把它列在目前工作區下而不再隱藏。
body.en:
Pulling up an in-progress session to resume used to break anywhere from the picker list to loading state, and those breakpoints are now fixed.

When a resume fails and returns to the session picker, the session you just tried is selected as soon as the list shows it, so pressing Enter no longer opens a different one by mistake.

When a session has to continue in a new session, resuming no longer fails even if its newest checkpoint was written between turns, and the conversation content is kept.

After compacting and reopening a session, saved workflows remain available to resume.

When reopening with `--resume`, `--continue`, or `/resume`, if a subagent (a separate helper that handles subtasks) cannot have its state read, expanded history no longer shows it twice.

Reopening a session no longer fails when saving setup failed on an earlier turn and the next turn reused the same rules or instructions.

If a forked session ran before recording its workspace, it claims that workspace on its next resume, and the picker lists it under the current workspace instead of hiding it.

items.original:
After a resume that fails and reopens the session picker, the session you tried is selected as soon as the picker lists it, so pressing Enter right away no longer opens a different session
Resuming a session that has to continue in a new session no longer fails when its newest checkpoint was written between turns; the conversation is kept
Keep saved workflows available to resume after compacting and reopening a session
Reopening a session with `--resume`, `--continue` or `/resume` no longer repeats an earlier subagent in expanded history when its saved subagent state could not be read
Reopening a session no longer fails when saving a turn's setup failed and the next turn reused the same rules or instructions
A forked session that ran before recording its workspace now takes the workspace on its next resume, so the resume picker lists it under the current workspace instead of hiding it as missing metadata

title.zh-TW: 列出工作階段不再佔用紀錄並標出分支對話
title.en: Session Listings Stop Holding Logs Open and Label Side Chats

body.zh-TW:
查看手邊留下的工作階段清單，現在跑起來不再卡住檔案，對話的上下歸屬也一眼就分得出。

列出工作階段清單預設改用兩階段執行，名單很長時不會在過程中一直開著紀錄檔；顯示出來的清單內容維持不變，但已經變得很龐大的舊紀錄檔目前還不會縮小。

執行 `muse sessions` 查看時，擱置在一旁的分支對話現在會標成隸屬原對話的分支，不再被當成旁邊一筆無主的工作階段。⟦像圖書館盤點書目時改分兩步抄錄，不再像以前那樣一路敞開書庫大門佔著通道，也會把擱在旁邊的副冊標明屬於哪套主書。⟧
body.en:
Checking your saved session list no longer locks up files while running, and how conversations relate to each other is clear at a glance.

Session listings now run in two phases by default, so long lists no longer keep log files open while running; the displayed list stays the same, though old log files that have already grown very large do not shrink yet.

When you run `muse sessions`, parked side chats are now labeled as branches of their original conversation instead of appearing beside it as unowned sessions. ⟦An inventory clerk at a library now copies catalog entries in two passes instead of propping the archive door open and blocking the aisle the whole time, while also labeling any side volume set aside with the main series it belongs to.⟧

items.original:
Session listings now run in two phases by default, so a long listing no longer holds the session log open while it runs; listings are unchanged, and logs that are already very large do not shrink yet
`muse sessions` shows a parked side chat as a side chat of its conversation (`sideOf`) instead of an anonymous session beside it

title.zh-TW: 閒置工作階段更快歸還對話壓縮釋出的記憶體
title.en: Idle Sessions Return Memory Freed by Compaction Faster

body.zh-TW: 開著好幾個對話視窗、剛做完紀錄壓縮又暫時沒繼續聊，電腦記憶體卻還是降不下來。過去工作階段常會把壓縮清出的記憶體扣留好幾分鐘，現在閒置約半分鐘就會把這塊記憶體歸還給系統。
body.en: Having several chat windows open after compacting logs and pausing the conversation used to leave your computer's memory usage stubbornly high. Previously, sessions often held onto the memory freed by compaction for several minutes; now, after sitting idle for about half a minute, they return that memory to the system.

items.original: An idle session now returns the memory a compaction freed to the system about half a minute later, instead of often holding it for minutes

title.zh-TW: 工作流程的 token 預算會完整計入子任務用量
title.en: Workflow token budgets fully count subtask usage

body.zh-TW: 執行多步驟的工作流程若分派子任務跑了好幾輪，以前計算出來的用量總是偏少。工作流程的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）預算與子任務消耗，現在會完整計入子任務所有階段的工作，不再只算它的第一輪。
body.en: When a multi-step workflow dispatches a subtask that runs for several turns, the calculated usage used to come up short. Workflow token (a unit of text used for AI processing and billing) budgets and subtask consumption now count all stages of a subtask's work, rather than only its first turn.

items.original: Workflow token budgets and child usage now count all of a child's work, not only its first turn

title.zh-TW: 修正背景任務觸發的審核與停止任務後排版異常
title.en: Fix background-task approvals and layout issues after stopping tasks

body.zh-TW:
把事情丟給背景任務去跑，等它結束或手動喊停後，畫面上的操作現在正常多了。

背景任務結束後送出的工作階段訊息，現在都能正常按核准。待審核的卡片上，也會把觸發訊息的背景任務與發送者分開顯示。

從 Tasks 抽屜或輸入 `/stop all` 停止任務後，下一則訊息底下不再多長出第二列輸入提示框。
body.en:
After handing work off to a background task and letting it finish or stopping it manually, on-screen controls now behave much better.

Session messages sent after a background task finishes can now be approved normally. Pending approval cards also show the background task trigger separately from the sender.

After stopping a task from the Tasks drawer or with `/stop all`, a second prompt row no longer appears under your next message.

items.original:
Session messages sent after a background task finishes can be approved normally. Pending approval cards show the background task trigger separately from the sender
Stopping a task from the Tasks drawer or with `/stop all` no longer adds a second prompt row under your next message

title.zh-TW: 修正排隊中的提問觸發掛鉤時變成空白的問題
title.en: Fix queued prompts arriving empty when triggering hooks

body.zh-TW: 上一輪還沒跑完時，你可以先送出下一句提問讓它排隊。以前 `UserPromptSubmit` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），這時收到的卻是一段空白。這個問題已經修好，現在排隊中的提問會帶著原本的文字內容正常傳進掛鉤。
body.en: While the previous turn is still running, you can submit your next prompt to queue it. Previously, `UserPromptSubmit` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) received an empty prompt in this case. This issue is fixed, and queued prompts now pass into the hooks with their original text.

items.original: A prompt queued behind a running turn now reaches its UserPromptSubmit hooks with its text instead of an empty prompt

title.zh-TW: 更新外掛後已停用的技能不再意外重新開啟
title.en: Disabled plugin skills stay off after updating the plugin

body.zh-TW: 自己手動關掉某個外掛裡用不到的技能，最怕更新外掛後它又自己跑出來。就算外掛作者改了那個技能的資料夾位置，你更新外掛後，原本停用的技能現在依然會維持關閉狀態。
body.en: When you manually turn off an unused skill in a plugin, the last thing you want is for it to turn back on after an update. Even if the plugin author moves that skill's folder, a skill you disabled now stays off after you update the plugin.

items.original: A plugin skill you turned off stays off after the plugin's author moves its folder and you update the plugin

title.zh-TW: 讀取未寫完的 JPEG 圖檔會直接提示檔案損毀
title.en: Reading incomplete JPEGs now reports a damaged file

body.zh-TW: 不小心把存到一半、結尾被截斷的 JPEG 圖片放進對話，過去程式會直接把這張壞圖送給模型，結果整個請求被拒收。現在讀到沒寫完整的 JPEG 時，會直接失敗並顯示 `"the file may be damaged or invalid"` 提示，不會再把損毀的圖片送給模型。
body.en: If you accidentally add a half-saved JPEG image that is cut off at the end to a conversation, the app used to send that broken image straight to the model, causing the whole request to be rejected. Reading an incomplete JPEG now fails immediately with the message `"the file may be damaged or invalid"`, instead of sending the damaged image to the model.

items.original: Reading a JPEG that is cut off before its end now fails with "the file may be damaged or invalid" instead of sending the broken image to the model, which rejected the request

title.zh-TW: settings.json 缺版本號時改為明確提示補法
title.en: Clearer guidance when settings.json lacks a version number

body.zh-TW:
如果電腦裡的 `settings.json` 是別的工具幫你建的，裡面常常少了格式版本編號，以前開啟 Muse 只會冷冰冰報出一條看不懂的解析錯誤。

現在遇到少了 `schema_version` 的情況，它會明確提示你在設定檔裡補上這行：

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1
}
```
body.en:
If `settings.json` on your computer was created by another tool, it often lacks a format version number, and opening Muse used to report only a cryptic parse error.

Now when `schema_version` is missing, it clearly tells you to add this line to the configuration file:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1
}
```

items.original: When `settings.json` has no `schema_version` (for example, another tool created it), Muse now says to add `"schema_version": 1` instead of reporting a bare parse error

title.zh-TW: settings.json 無法讀取時各啟動指令的阻擋規則
title.en: Startup blocking rules when settings.json cannot be read

body.zh-TW:
如果不小心把 `settings.json` 的權限鎖死、誰都打不開，接下來不同情境的啟動行為會怎麼處理，這版劃分得更清楚。

用 `muse serve` 讀取掛鉤清單遇到這種情況，不再回報成沒有掛鉤，改為直接拒絕並附上讀取錯誤與修正建議。改用 `muse resume <id>` 或 `muse exec --session-id <id>` 接續工作階段，啟動時也會以相同原因停止。

若是全新執行 `muse` 或 `muse exec`，仍維持原本的權限設定檔拒絕行為。至於不會執行任何掛鉤的指令，則會在跳出一次警告後繼續用預設設定跑下去。⟦彷彿工地的安全手冊泡水糊掉看不清，需要照手冊施工的班組不再假裝沒限制就開工，會先停工並附上排除步驟；不牽涉手冊的作業則記一筆提醒後照常完成。⟧
body.en:
If you accidentally lock down permissions on `settings.json` so nobody can open it, this release draws clearer lines around how startup behaves in each scenario.

When `muse serve` hits this while reading the hooks list, it no longer reports zero hooks and instead refuses with the read error and a fix suggestion. Resuming a session with `muse resume <id>` or `muse exec --session-id <id>` also stops at startup for the same reason.

A fresh `muse` or `muse exec` run keeps its existing permission-profile refusal. Commands that run no hooks continue using defaults after showing a single warning. ⟦When a construction site's safety manual gets waterlogged and unreadable, crews that must follow the manual no longer pretend there are no restrictions and start work—they halt first and include troubleshooting steps, while tasks unrelated to the manual log a reminder and finish as usual.⟧

items.original: `muse serve`'s hooks catalog read (`hook/list`) on a `settings.json` nobody could read now refuses with the read error and a recovery line instead of reporting zero hooks, and a resumed start (`muse resume <id>`, `muse exec --session-id <id>`) stops with the same refusal; a fresh `muse` or `muse exec` start keeps its permission-profile refusal, and commands that run no hooks keep continuing on defaults with the one warning

title.zh-TW: 讀不到 trust.json 時工作階段仍可開啟
title.en: Sessions still open when trust.json cannot be read

body.zh-TW: 透過 `muse serve` 確認工作區信任狀態時，萬一記錄信任清單的檔案損壞或權限卡住，過去會直接失敗進不去。這個問題已經修好，現在讀不到 `trust.json` 時工作階段依然能正常打開，只是額外加入的工作區資料夾會先留在未信任狀態。
body.en: When checking workspace trust through `muse serve`, if the file recording the trust list was damaged or blocked by permissions, opening used to fail outright. This issue is fixed: when `trust.json` cannot be read, the session still opens normally, with any extra workspace folders left untrusted.

items.original: A session that asks `muse serve` for workspace trust now opens with its extra workspace folders untrusted when `trust.json` cannot be read, instead of failing to open

title.zh-TW: Mac 沙盒內執行殼層指令也能正常使用 ssh
title.en: Shell commands in the Mac sandbox can use ssh normally

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 開啟隔離環境跑終端命令時，過去只要用到遠端連線工具 `ssh`，往往會卡在查不到目前使用者名稱。這個問題已經修好，現在沙盒（隔離執行環境的安全空間）內的殼層指令能正常查詢使用者名稱，讓 `ssh` 就像在沙盒外一樣運作。
body.en: When running terminal commands in an isolated environment on macOS, using the remote connection tool `ssh` used to get stuck unable to look up the current user name. This issue is fixed, so shell commands inside the sandbox (an isolated, secure execution environment) can look up the user name normally and `ssh` works just as it does outside the sandbox.

items.original: Shell commands sandboxed on macOS can look up the current user name, so ssh works as it does outside the sandbox

title.zh-TW: Mac 無法存取鑰匙圈時登入畫面會給解法
title.en: Mac login screen explains how to fix Keychain access issues

body.zh-TW:
從別台電腦透過 SSH 遠端連進蘋果電腦啟動 Muse Code 時，過去常會莫名跳出未登入狀態，畫面上卻完全沒寫到底哪裡出錯。

這通常是因為啟動時無法使用鑰匙圈。現在碰到這種情況，登入畫面會直接說明原因並附上解法，提醒你先執行 `security unlock-keychain`，再重新啟動 Muse Code。⟦像刷門禁卡進不了辦公室，以前只會亮紅燈把你當成沒報到，現在螢幕會直接告訴你卡片消磁了，並教你在哪台機器重新過卡。⟧
body.en:
When starting Muse Code on a Mac over a remote SSH connection from another computer, it used to unexpectedly show a logged-out state with no explanation on screen of what went wrong.

This usually happens because the Keychain cannot be used at startup. Now in this situation, the login screen explains the cause and includes the fix, reminding you to run `security unlock-keychain` and then restart Muse Code. ⟦Suppose your keycard fails to open the office door: before, the reader only flashed red and treated you as absent, whereas now the screen tells you the card is demagnetized and shows which machine to use to re-encode it.⟧

items.original: On a Mac where Muse Code cannot use the Keychain at startup, such as over SSH, the login screen now says why and how to fix it (run `security unlock-keychain` and restart Muse Code) instead of looking logged out with no explanation

title.zh-TW: Windows 沙盒設定失敗時會指出卡關步驟
title.en: Windows sandbox setup now names the step where it failed

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上執行 `muse sandbox windows setup` 或首次啟動自動建立沙盒時，設定有時會在中途失敗。以前這時畫面上只會報說找不到設定標記，讓人完全摸不著頭緒到底錯在哪裡。

現在失敗訊息會直接點出卡關的具體步驟，例如公司電腦或本機原則拒絕沙盒帳號登入這類狀況，不必再盲猜原因。
body.en:
Running `muse sandbox windows setup` on Windows, or letting the first launch create the sandbox automatically, can sometimes fail mid-way. Previously, the screen only reported that the setup marker was missing, leaving you with no clue what went wrong.

Now the failure message points directly to the specific step that got stuck—such as a company machine or local policy refusing sign-in for the sandbox account—so you no longer have to guess the cause.

items.original: On Windows, a failed `muse sandbox windows setup`, or the setup a first start runs, now names the step that failed, such as a sign-in the machine's policy refuses for the sandbox account, instead of only reporting that its setup marker is missing

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 沙盒內附加圖片跳出存取遭拒
title.en: Fixed "Access is denied" when attaching images in a Windows sandbox

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦的沙盒環境這類不允許建立硬連結的工作階段資料夾裡操作時，想在對話附上圖片會直接失敗並跳出「Access is denied」錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在就算資料夾不支援硬連結，圖片也能正常附加進去。
body.en: When working in a session folder on Windows that does not allow hard links, such as inside a sandbox environment, trying to attach an image to a conversation failed with an "Access is denied" error. This issue is now fixed, so images attach normally even when the folder does not support hard links.

items.original: Attaching an image no longer fails with "Access is denied" on Windows when the session folder does not allow hard links, for example inside a sandbox

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux 沙盒同時執行指令時的保護與啟動錯誤
title.en: Fixed protection and startup failures for concurrent Linux sandbox commands

body.zh-TW:
在 Linux 上同時跑多個受沙盒保護的殼層指令，或遇到系統定時清掉暫存檔，以前常出現啟動失敗或防護失效的狀況。

當 `~/.config` 目錄還沒建立時，若同時啟動兩個沙盒殼層指令，第二個不會再以 `exit 125` 失敗。

用來防止沙盒指令互相拆掉保護的共用鎖，不再放在暫存清理程式會在執行中途刪掉的檔案裡。

若沙盒的佔位紀錄被 `/tmp` 清理程式等工具刪掉，就算另一個共用的指令先跑完，對 `~/.config` 這類未建路徑的保護也不會消失。

當同一工作區有另一個沙盒指令啟動時，未建立的受保護資料夾（例如 `.git`）內部的拒絕規則不會再丟失。
body.en:
Running multiple sandboxed shell commands at the same time on Linux, or hitting a scheduled system temp-file cleanup, previously caused startup failures or dropped protections.

When the `~/.config` directory does not exist yet and two sandboxed shell commands start together, the second command no longer fails with `exit 125`.

The shared lock that stops sandboxed commands from undoing each other's protection no longer lives in a file that a temp cleaner can delete mid-run.

If the sandbox's placeholder records are deleted by a `/tmp` cleaner or similar tool, protection for missing paths like `~/.config` no longer disappears even when another command sharing it finishes first.

When another sandboxed command starts in the same workspace, deny rules inside a missing protected folder (such as `.git`) are no longer lost.

items.original:
On Linux, when two sandboxed shell commands start at the same time while `~/.config` does not exist yet, the second no longer fails with exit 125
On Linux, the shared lock that keeps sandboxed commands from removing each other's protection of a missing denied path no longer lives in a file a temp cleaner can delete out from under a running command
On Linux, a sandboxed shell command no longer loses the protection of a missing path such as `~/.config` when another command sharing it finishes first after the sandbox's placeholder records were deleted, for example by a `/tmp` cleaner
On Linux, a sandboxed shell command no longer loses a deny inside a missing protected folder such as `.git` when another sandboxed command starts in the same workspace

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux worktree 子目錄指令失敗
title.en: Fixed shell command failures in Linux worktree subdirectories

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 上，很多人會用 `git worktree add` 開出 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。過去只要從這種目錄底下的子資料夾啟動 Muse，每條殼層指令都會跳出 `"Not a directory"` 錯誤。現在這個問題已經修好，從子目錄啟動也能正常執行殼層指令。
body.en: On Linux, many users create a worktree (a Git feature that lets you check out multiple parallel copies of the same project) with `git worktree add`. Previously, starting Muse from a subfolder inside such a directory caused every shell command to fail with a `"Not a directory"` error. That issue is now fixed, and shell commands run normally from subdirectories.

items.original: On Linux, shell commands now run when Muse starts in a subdirectory of a Git worktree created with `git worktree add`, instead of every command failing with a "Not a directory" error

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定新增子代理停止與結果狀態通知
title.en: Session protocol adds subagent stop and result status notifications

body.zh-TW:
給開發自家前端介面的串接團隊：過去在外部畫面不容易看清背景任務是被使用者叫停、還是已經把產出交回主線，這版把這類即時同步補齊了。

工作階段協定新增一項實驗性請求，能像終端機介面按下停止一樣中止工作階段內的子代理，並讓主代理得知是使用者停止的。

每當工作階段讀取子代理結果時，用戶端會在該位置收到結果項目與當下狀態，包含已完成、失敗或已取消，好把結束的子代理標在父層讀取結果處。

當子代理在舊結果之後又展開新的嘗試，該筆舊結果會被標成已被新嘗試取代，用戶端就能直接從控制狀態判別子代理目前狀況。
body.en:
For teams building custom frontend interfaces: previously, external views could not easily tell whether a background task was stopped by the user or had already handed its output back to the main thread, and this release fills in that real-time sync.

The session protocol adds an experimental request that stops subagents in a session just like pressing stop in the terminal UI, letting the main agent know the user stopped them.

Whenever a session reads a subagent's result, the client receives a result item with its current status—completed, failed, or cancelled—at that point, so finished subagents can be shown where the parent read the result.

When a subagent starts a new attempt after an older result, that older result is marked as superseded by the newer attempt, allowing clients to read the subagent's current status directly from its control state.

items.original:
The session protocol gains an experimental `subagent/workStop` request that stops a session's subagents the way the terminal UI's own stop does, so the agent is told the user stopped them
Session-protocol clients get a `subagentResult` item each time a session consumes a subagent's result, at that point in the session, with the result's status (`completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`) when the view saw it, so a client can show each finished subagent where its parent read the result
A `subagent` item's `result` in the session protocol now carries `superseded: true` once the subagent started a newer attempt after that result, so a client can take the subagent's status from its control state

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理指令在無法存檔時回報錯誤不準的問題
title.en: Fixed inaccurate save-error reporting for subagent commands

body.zh-TW:
對串接工作階段協定或 `muse serve` 的開發團隊來說，過去子代理無法處理指令時，畫面或回應常把原因一律寫成無法儲存，讓人誤判問題。

當工作階段紀錄檔在 Muse 外部被刪除或替換後，協定若拒絕中斷、停止、關閉子代理或讀取結果的請求，現在會明確回報拒絕原因，不再只說變更無法儲存。

在 `muse serve` 工作階段接續後、歷史紀錄還在重建期間送出指令給子代理，現在會直接回覆它忙碌中且可重試。就算當下工作階段無法存檔，也不再為沒執行到的指令報出儲存失敗。⟦像櫃檯人員以前只要件送不進去就一律貼「系統無法存檔」的標籤，現在會老實寫明是底稿不見還是窗口還在整理舊件、請稍後再試。⟧
body.en:
For teams integrating the session protocol or `muse serve`, screens and responses previously labeled any unhandled subagent command as unable to save, misleading people about the real cause.

When a session log file is deleted or replaced outside Muse and the protocol refuses an interrupt, stop, close, or result-read request for a subagent, it now reports the exact reason for the refusal instead of only saying changes cannot be saved.

On a `muse serve` session, sending a command to a subagent after resume while its history is still being rebuilt now replies that it is busy and can be retried. Even when the session cannot be saved at that moment, it no longer reports a save failure for a command that never ran. ⟦A front-desk clerk who used to slap an "unable to save" label on any rejected filing now states plainly whether the master copy is missing or the counter is still sorting old paperwork and asks you to try again.⟧

items.original:
After a session log is deleted or replaced outside Muse, a subagent interrupt, stop, close or result read that the session protocol refuses now says why instead of saying the change can't be saved
On a `muse serve` session, a command sent to a subagent while its history is still being rebuilt after a resume now answers that the subagent is busy and can be retried, even when the session cannot be saved, instead of reporting a save failure for a command that never ran

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定改用新版檢視游標並重建舊快取
title.en: Session protocol adopts new view cursors and rebuilds old caches

body.zh-TW:
給串接遠端用戶端的開發者：升級後如果繼續沿用舊版留下的閱讀進度或暫存紀錄，畫面可能會默默漏接或讀錯事件，這版會主動攔下並刷新。

工作階段協定的檢視游標現在改以新版格式核發，遇到舊格式游標會被拒絕一次，並附上標準的 `reopen without a cursor` 指引要求不帶游標重新開啟。至於舊版存下來的檢視快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用的空間），則會在首次使用時自動重建。⟦像進新版閱讀室時舊書籤不再通用，服務員會先請你把書重頭翻開一次，並把夾在裡頭的舊索引頁當場重印，免得你漏看章節。⟧
body.en:
For developers integrating remote clients: continuing to use reading progress or cached records left over from older versions after an upgrade could cause views to silently miss or misread events, so this release actively intercepts and refreshes them.

Session-protocol view cursors are now issued in a new format; an older-format cursor is refused once with the standard `reopen without a cursor` guidance asking to reopen without a cursor. Any view cache saved by an older version is automatically rebuilt on first use. ⟦At a renovated reading room, old bookmarks no longer work: the attendant asks you to reopen the book from the start and reprints the old index sheet tucked inside so you do not miss any chapters.⟧

items.original: Session-protocol clients: view cursors are now minted in the `v10:` spelling; a cursor in an older spelling is refused once with the standard "reopen without a cursor" guidance, and a view cache saved by an older build is rebuilt on first use, so no client silently skips or misreads events

title.zh-TW: muse serve 支援在單一回合混搭技能與影片
title.en: muse serve supports mixing skills and videos in a single turn

body.zh-TW:
如果你的專案有串接 `muse serve` 用戶端，以前想把技能跟多段影片放進同一回合分析，還得拆開處理。

現在發起單一回合時，用戶端可以直接把技能片段連同影片片段一起送出。每段影片對應的 `[Video #N]` 標籤會依照順序接進技能的參數裡，作法跟既有的圖片標籤完全相同。
body.en:
If your project integrates a `muse serve` client, putting a skill and multiple videos into the same turn for analysis previously had to be split apart.

Now when starting a single turn, clients can send skill parts together with video parts. Each video's `[Video #N]` label is appended to the skill's arguments in order, working the same way as existing image labels.

items.original: `muse serve` clients can send a skill part together with video parts in one `turn/start`; each video's `[Video #N]` label joins the skill's arguments in order, as image labels already do

title.zh-TW: SDK 新增工作階段事件串流與實驗請求
title.en: SDKs add session event streaming and generic requests

body.zh-TW:
使用 TypeScript 與 Python SDK 的開發者，想更細緻追蹤狀態或呼叫尚未封裝的介面，這版補齊了幾項關鍵能力。

在 TypeScript SDK 中，擴充掛鉤現在能觀察工作階段摺疊過程裡的自訂通知，以及整個主機範圍的事件。

在 TypeScript 與 Python SDK 裡，新的事件串流介面會即時送出每個傳入事件對工作階段帶來的變更，讓用戶端可以逐步局部更新畫面。

兩個 SDK 也新增了通用查詢請求方法，專門處理用戶端尚未封裝的查詢；而且只要在啟動用戶端時開啟實驗性 API 選項，一般指令與通用請求都能呼叫實驗性方法。
body.en:
For developers using the TypeScript and Python SDKs who want finer-grained state tracking or to call unwrapped interfaces, this release fills in several key capabilities.

In the TypeScript SDK, extension hooks can now observe custom notifications during session folding as well as host-wide events.

In both the TypeScript and Python SDKs, a new event-streaming interface sends the changes each incoming event makes to a session in real time, letting clients update their UI incrementally.

Both SDKs also add a generic query request method for queries not yet wrapped by the client; and when the experimental API option is enabled at client startup, both regular commands and generic requests can call experimental methods.

items.original:
TypeScript SDK: `FoldExtension` hooks observe custom notifications in the session fold and host-wide events
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events()` streams what each incoming event changed in a session, so a client can update its view incrementally
The TypeScript and Python SDKs add `MuseClient.request` for queries the client does not wrap, and `command` and `request` send experimental methods when the client is spawned with `experimentalApi: true`

title.zh-TW: 修正 SDK 主機當掉錯誤回報與重試行為
title.en: Fixed SDK host-crash error reporting and retry behavior

body.zh-TW:
採用 TypeScript 與 Python SDK 開發時，遇到主機中斷或系統忙碌，錯誤資訊與重送機制這版都做了修正。

當呼叫因主機行程結束而失敗，錯誤原因現在會附上結束方式（包含結束碼或訊號，以及錯誤輸出尾端）。這類失敗在 SDK 等待行程結束時最多會晚 2 秒才報錯，而且這個原因不代表工作階段能夠接續。

指令若收到系統過載或請求塞車的推回回應，且標明不可重試，SDK 不再自動重送；若沒帶該標記仍會繼續重試。

送出意見回饋的呼叫不再附上指令識別碼，收到系統過載或推回回應後也不再重送，每次呼叫就是單一次送出。

關於 Muse Code 主機的 SDK 錯誤訊息中，相容性連結現在會連往正確的相容性頁面，不再開啟失效頁面。
body.en:
When developing with the TypeScript and Python SDKs, error details and retry behavior for host disconnects or busy states have been fixed in this release.

When a call fails because the host process exited, the error cause now includes how it ended (exit code or signal, plus the tail of its error output). Such failures can be reported up to 2 seconds later while the SDK waits for the process to exit, and this cause does not mean the session can be resumed.

If a command receives an overload or backpressure pushback marked as not retryable, the SDK no longer resubmits it automatically; without that flag, it still retries.

Feedback submission calls no longer attach a command ID and no longer retry after an overload or pushback response, making each call a single submission.

In SDK error messages about the Muse Code host, the compatibility link now points to the right compatibility page instead of opening a broken one.

items.original:
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, a call that fails because the host process died now says how it ended (exit code or signal, and the end of its error output) in the error's cause; such a call can fail up to 2 seconds later while the SDK waits for that exit, and the cause does not mean the session can be resumed
Python and TypeScript SDKs: a command answered `overloaded` or `backpressured` with `retryable: false` is no longer resubmitted automatically; without the flag it still retries
The compatibility link in the SDK errors about the Muse Code host now opens the compatibility page instead of a missing page
Python and TypeScript SDKs: `submitFeedback` / `submit_feedback` no longer attaches a `commandId` to `feedback/submit` or resubmits it after a `backpressured` or `overloaded` answer; each call is one submit, as the wire defines it

title.zh-TW: 編輯器可透過預設開啟的 muse acp 直接呼叫 Muse
title.en: Editors can invoke Muse directly through default-on muse acp

body.zh-TW: 平常在編輯器裡想直接叫出代理幫忙，還得先手動開啟介面往往多了一道工。現在 `muse acp` 改為預設開啟，像是 Zed 這類支援 Agent Client Protocol（讓編輯器與代理溝通的標準協定）的編輯器，都能直接把 Muse 當作代理來運作。當你打開 Zed 準備修改手邊的筆記或程式時，不用再另外開啟開關就能立即指派 Muse 執行任務，不過這組介面目前仍屬實驗性質，後續版本可能會再調整。⟦就像新買的設備出廠就已插好通用規格的轉接頭，以前得自己接線打開開關才能配對，現在只要編輯器支援同一套插座就能直接連上。⟧
body.en: When you want an agent's help directly inside your editor, having to open an interface by hand first often adds an extra step. Now `muse acp` is turned on by default, so editors that support the Agent Client Protocol (a standard way for editors and agents to communicate), such as Zed, can run Muse directly as their agent. When you open Zed to edit your notes or code, you can assign tasks to Muse right away without flipping another switch, though this surface is still experimental and may change in a later release. ⟦A newly bought device ships with a universal adapter already plugged in—previously you had to wire it up and flip a switch to pair, whereas now any editor with that same socket connects right away.⟧

items.original: `muse acp` is on by default, so editors that support the Agent Client Protocol (like Zed) can run Muse as their agent; the surface is experimental and may change in a later release

title.zh-TW: 支援以 prompt.surfaces 與空白設定關閉開發者提示詞
title.en: Turn off developer prompts with prompt.surfaces and blank settings

body.zh-TW: 對話剛起步時若想關掉一部分預設提示，過去較難照個別需要一一拿掉。在全域或專案設定裡加入 `prompt.surfaces`（可附帶選用的 `default` 預設值），或是透過工作階段設定覆寫，就能依 ID 關閉指定的開發者提示詞區塊。目前有五個受保護的區塊會繼續維持開啟，如果設定裡填了不認識的 ID，啟動時會跳過並顯示通知，而由工作階段直接送出未知 ID 則會遭到拒絕。當你想在特定專注寫作的工作階段完全退出 Muse 內建的開發者脈絡，只要在工作階段設定中把 `developerPrompt` 設為 `null` 或空字串即可。⟦跟點餐時勾選客製化選項一樣，以前固定配料會整盤端上桌，現在能按編號拿掉不要的區塊，或乾脆整份不加預設底料。⟧
body.en: When starting a conversation, turning off only part of the default prompts used to be hard to tailor piece by piece. Add `prompt.surfaces` (with an optional `default`) to global or project settings, or override it in session settings, to turn off specific developer-prompt blocks by ID. Five protected blocks stay on for now; an unrecognized ID in settings is skipped with a startup notice, while sending an unknown ID directly from a session is refused. When you want a focused writing session to opt out of Muse's built-in developer context completely, set `developerPrompt` to `null` or an empty string in that session's config. ⟦Like checking custom options when ordering a meal, fixed toppings used to arrive all at once on the plate, whereas now you can remove unwanted items by number or skip the default base altogether.⟧

items.original:
A `prompt.surfaces` setting turns developer-prompt blocks off by id (with an optional `default`) in global or project settings, and per session through session settings overrides; the five protected blocks stay on for now, and an unknown id is skipped with a startup notice (refused when a session sends it)
Setting `developerPrompt` to a null or empty value in a session config now opts that session out of Muse's own developer context

title.zh-TW: 重開終端機工作階段可保存並套用新版開發者指令
title.en: Reopened terminal sessions save and apply updated developer instructions

body.zh-TW: 中斷對話後想改掉背景規範再接著聊，以前重開工作階段往往還是沿用舊指令。現在每次工作階段啟動時都會先記錄開發者指令，只要你在設定裡修改 `run.developer_prompt`，再於終端機透過 `--resume`、`--continue` 或 `tbh exec --session-id` 重開工作階段，Muse 就會存下新版內容並從下一輪開始套用。對於由這一版建立或更新過開發者指令的工作階段，若某次執行正處於第一步，遠端的傳送、開啟、列表或輪詢操作可能會等到該步驟的檢查點完成，但絕不會超過呼叫本身的期限。其他既有工作階段則不受影響，不過現在新建立的工作階段無法用關閉此功能的舊版本開啟。⟦就像登機前先在櫃檯建檔規範，修改後重辦登機便會換上新版，起飛第一步完成前遠端查詢會稍等檢查紀錄，只是舊版閘門還讀不懂新檔案。⟧
body.en: If you paused a conversation and wanted to change its background guidelines before continuing, reopening the session used to keep the old instructions. Muse now records developer instructions each time a session starts, so when you edit `run.developer_prompt` in your settings and reopen the session in the terminal with `--resume`, `--continue`, or `tbh exec --session-id`, it saves the new text and applies it from the next turn. On a session whose developer instructions were created or updated by this release, a remote send, open, list, or poll made while a run is in its first step may wait until that step's checkpoint finishes, never past the call's own deadline. Other existing sessions are unaffected, though sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this feature turned off. ⟦Think of filing guidelines at the check-in counter before boarding: updating them and checking in again switches to the new version, remote inquiries wait briefly for the checkpoint before the first step of takeoff finishes, and older gates cannot read the new file yet.⟧

items.original: Muse now records each session's developer instructions when it starts. When you reopen a session in the terminal (`--resume`, `--continue` or `tbh exec --session-id`) after changing `run.developer_prompt` in your settings, Muse saves the new text and uses it from the next turn. On a session whose developer instructions were set by this release's start or update, a remote send, open, list or poll made while a run is in its first step can wait until that step's checkpoint, never past the call's own deadline; other sessions see no change. Sessions created now cannot be opened by an older build that has this off

title.zh-TW: 工作階段語言鎖定改依使用者訊息於首段輸出宣告
title.en: Session language pin now declared from first output based on user messages

body.zh-TW: 專案夾雜大量英文程式碼或名詞時，你可能擔心對話回覆被裡頭的字詞帶偏語言。⟦好比飯店櫃檯直接聽住客本人說什麼語言就用那種語言回應，而不是看護照夾裡的英文備註或行李標籤亂猜，從第一句問候就說對語言，住客還沒開口前則先用英文招呼。⟧在符合條件的主執行流程中，Muse 現在會從第一段可見輸出就明確宣告你的工作階段語言釘選（鎖定這段對話該使用的回覆語言）。這個語言設定會固定依據你在該工作階段發送的訊息推算出來，不會再從名稱、程式碼或工具輸出推斷語言。當你輸入的內容還沒有明顯語言訊號時，則會採用英文作為預設語言。
body.en: When a project mixes in lots of English code or terms, you might worry that replies will be swayed by those words into the wrong language. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk listening directly to what the guest speaks and replying in kind rather than guessing from English notes in a passport holder or luggage tags, getting the greeting right from the first word and defaulting to English before the guest speaks.⟧ On eligible main runs, Muse now explicitly states your session language pin (which locks the reply choice for this conversation) from the first visible output. This language setting is derived deterministically from the messages you send in the session, rather than inferred from names, code, or tool output. When your input carries no clear language signal yet, English is used as the default.

items.original: Muse now states your session language pin on eligible main runs from the first visible output, deriving the pin deterministically from your own messages in the session (English when your input carries no language signal yet) instead of inferring a language from names, code, or tool output

title.zh-TW: 動手修改前核對更嚴謹並於受阻時先停下詢問
title.en: Stricter checks before editing and pausing to ask when blocked

body.zh-TW: 把專案交給代理查問題或修程式，最怕它太快下結論說找不到檔案，或自己繞過限制硬闖。⟦宛如老練的水電師傅進屋檢修，找不到管線先換幾個角落巡一遍、確認哪一戶報修、照原況重試一次再動扳手，碰到社區禁令或斷水閥門就停下來問屋主，絕不擅自繞道。⟧現在 Muse 動手前會把每一步核對得更仔細：宣告東西不存在前，會先試別種拼法與更寬的路徑；著手修復前，會先確認回報指向哪一份程式碼複本，並在原本出錯的環境設定下重跑具名的失敗測試。查案時也會讀取版本庫自己的歷史紀錄與上游分支。若變動受到版本庫規則禁止或管制，或是網路政策擋住某個步驟，它都會停下來詢問你，不再自己繞道處理。
body.en: When handing a project to an agent to investigate or fix, it is frustrating if it jumps too quickly to saying a file is missing or forces its way around limits. ⟦A seasoned plumber inspecting a house checks other corners before saying a pipe is missing, confirms which unit filed the report, and retries under the original conditions before touching a wrench, stopping to ask the homeowner rather than routing around a building rule or shutoff valve.⟧ Muse now verifies each step more carefully before acting: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, confirms which copy of the code a report points to before fixing it, and reruns named failing tests in the setup where they failed. It also reads the repository's own history and upstream branch while investigating. If a change is forbidden or gated by a repository rule, or if a network policy blocks a step, it stops to ask you instead of routing around it.

items.original: Muse checks its work more carefully: it tries other spellings and wider paths before saying something does not exist, finds which copy of the code a report is about before fixing it, reruns named failing tests in the setup they failed in, asks before a change a repository rule forbids or gates, reads the repository's own history and upstream branch, and stops to ask when a network policy blocks a step instead of routing around it

title.zh-TW: 產出結果若落在別處直接補進指定位置
title.en: Results built elsewhere are added directly to the requested spot

body.zh-TW: 有時請代理產出內容，它卻把結果做在你最初指定以外的地方，還得你多點一次確認才肯搬過來。現在就算 Muse 把成果建在別的畫面、分頁、頁面或檔案裡，它也不會停下來問你要不要移過去，而是繼續完成並直接加進你當初要求的位置。當你在寫報告或整理筆記，指定要把段落補進某份檔案時，不用再多回一句「好，幫我放進去」就能直接看到結果到位。⟦猶如請人把整理好的資料放進指定抽屜，以前做完留在餐桌上還要問一聲要不要搬，現在會直接放進你說的抽屜才收工。⟧
body.en: Sometimes you ask an agent to produce something, and it builds the result somewhere other than where you first asked, leaving you to confirm one more time before moving it over. Now even if Muse builds a result in a different screen, tab, page, or file, it will not stop to ask whether to move it, and instead finishes the work and adds it directly where you asked. When you are writing a report or organizing notes and ask for a section to be added to a specific file, you see it land in place without having to reply "yes, put it in." ⟦Compare that to asking someone to put sorted papers into a specific drawer: before, they left them on the dining table and asked whether to move them, whereas now they place them straight into the drawer before wrapping up.⟧

items.original: Muse keeps working when it built a result somewhere other than the screen, tab, page, or file you named, and adds it where you asked instead of offering to

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段接近容量上限時改要簡短回覆
title.en: Long sessions request shorter replies when nearing capacity

body.zh-TW: 同一段對話聊久了、貼入的資料一多，最掃興的就是準備收尾時突然被一句超出容量擋在半路。⟦恰似裝行李快到登機箱極限時，工作人員不再直接拒收整箱物件，而是改請你挑最精簡的幾件塞進剩餘空間。⟧過去長工作階段只要輸入內容加上請求的輸出長度超過模型的脈絡視窗（模型單次能同時處理的文字容量），就會跳出錯誤並強制停下。現在當脈絡視窗快滿時，Muse 會主動請模型改給較簡短的回覆，讓工作階段繼續進行而不致中斷。
body.en: Nothing spoils the wrap-up of a long conversation packed with pasted material like suddenly hitting a capacity wall. ⟦When packing a carry-on approaches the size limit, staff no longer turn away the whole bag and instead ask you to pick only the most compact items for the remaining space.⟧ Previously, a long session stopped with an error whenever its input plus requested output exceeded the model's context window (how much text a model can handle at once). Now, when the context window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply so the session can keep going without stopping.

items.original: A long session no longer stops with an error that its input plus the requested output exceeds the model's context window: when the window is nearly full, Muse asks the model for a shorter reply instead

title.zh-TW: 含大量截圖的工作階段壓縮後最多保留約八張近期原圖
title.en: Compacted screenshot-heavy sessions keep up to about eight recent originals

body.zh-TW: 除錯或做設計時常在對話裡貼進一張張螢幕截圖，以前這類工作階段一旦執行壓縮，很容易直接跳過存檔，導致後面想接續對話無從接起。現在壓縮近期回合含大量完整尺寸圖片（例如截圖）的工作階段時，多數情況都能順利存下檢查點，讓你從該處繼續接續工作階段。壓縮後的脈絡會原封不動保留最近最多約八張完整尺寸的圖片；較早的圖片會改為摘要；若單批超過八張，該整批也會改為摘要。⟦如同整理旅行相簿，以前塞滿高畫質相片就整本卡住封存不了，現在可留下部分近期原片，把舊相片改寫成摘要；單批超過八張則整批摘要歸檔。⟧
body.en: Debugging or designing often fills a conversation with screenshots, and compacting those sessions used to skip saving a checkpoint, leaving you with nowhere to resume. Now when compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images (such as screenshots), it saves its checkpoint in most cases so you can resume from that point. The compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images are summarized, and if a single batch has more than eight, that entire batch is summarized too. ⟦Sorting a travel photo album used to stall the whole archive whenever it was packed with high-resolution shots, whereas now you can keep a portion of recent originals and turn older photos—or any single batch over eight—into summaries.⟧

items.original: Compacting a session whose recent turns hold many full-size images, such as screenshots, now saves its checkpoint in most cases instead of skipping it, so the session can resume from that point; the compacted context keeps up to about eight recent full-size images as they are; older images, and a single batch of more than eight, are summarized

title.zh-TW: 工作階段壓縮後分支或重開保留目標與背景復原
title.en: Compacted sessions keep goals and background recovery when forked or reopened

body.zh-TW:
工作階段經過壓縮後，無論是從中開出新分支還是重新打開接續，過去都容易在交接處出錯。⟦想像把長篇筆記精簡裝訂成精華冊，以前拆成新副本或重翻頁面時總會掉頁失聯，現在關鍵的索引與行程紀錄都穩穩留在冊子裡。⟧

在 `muse serve` 中針對已壓縮的工作階段分支對話（包括從它啟動的子代理），即使後續回合的指令只留在壓縮檢查點裡，現在也不再因為被判成格式錯誤的工作階段日誌而失敗。

設有目標的工作階段重新開啟後再進行分支時，就算該工作階段曾經在某個回合進行到一半時執行壓縮，現在也能順利分支而不報錯。

把工作階段壓縮並重新開啟之後，原本在背後運行的背景代理復原能力現在也能完整保留下來。
body.en:
After a session is compacted, both branching off a new conversation and reopening it to continue used to break at the handoff. ⟦Imagine binding long notes into a condensed booklet: splitting off a new copy or flipping back through pages used to drop sheets and lose track, whereas now key indexes and trip records stay intact inside.⟧

Forking a compacted session in `muse serve` (including any subagent started from it) no longer fails as a malformed session log even when later turns' instructions live only in the compaction checkpoint.

Forking a resumed session that has a goal now succeeds without error even if the session was compacted mid-turn.

Background agent recovery is now preserved after compacting and reopening a session.

items.original:
On a `muse serve` session that has compacted, forking the conversation, including a subagent that starts from it, no longer fails as a malformed session log when a later turn's instructions are kept only by the compaction checkpoint
Preserve background agent recovery after compacting and reopening a session
Forking a resumed session that has a goal no longer fails when the session compacted in the middle of a turn

title.zh-TW: 精簡長工作階段大量子代理的存檔與記憶體佔用
title.en: Trim saved state and memory use for long sessions with many subagents

body.zh-TW:
接手跑了很久、中途派過不少子代理分頭做事的對話時，以前重開畫面常覺得越跑越沉，甚至等半天才看到回覆。⟦彷彿爬山途中把已經吃完的乾糧包裝收進回收袋輕裝上路，過去空盒子全都繼續背在肩上越走越沉，現在只留沿途還用得上的補給。⟧

啟動大量子代理的長工作階段不會再突然停止儲存檢查點：只要某個子代理已經結束、主代理也已讀過它的結果（例如等待它完成），就算沒人手動關閉，只要對話不再提及它就會自動從存檔的工作階段中移除。

重開長工作階段時佔用的記憶體變少了，因為保留在記憶體裡的每筆工具任務紀錄體積都更小。

重開包含長串子代理歷史的工作階段後，畫面顯示回覆的延遲也獲得縮減。

重開帶有許多已完成子代理的工作階段時，首次讀取每個子代理會耗用更少記憶體並減少處理工時，因為已完成子代理的工具歷史不再被複製進追蹤子代理嘗試次數的紀錄簿裡。
body.en:
When picking up a long-running conversation that spawned many subagents to split the work, reopening the screen used to feel sluggish and take ages to show a reply. ⟦On a mountain hike, packing empty ration wrappers into a recycling bag lightens the load—instead of carrying every empty box on your shoulders and growing heavier, you keep only the supplies still needed along the trail.⟧

Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a subagent finishes and the main agent has read its result (for example by waiting for it to finish), it automatically drops out of the saved session as soon as the conversation stops mentioning it, even if nobody closed it manually.

Resuming a long session uses less memory because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller.

Reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories are also reduced.

Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and less work when first reading each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts.

items.original:
Long sessions that start many subagents no longer stop saving checkpoints: a subagent that finished and whose result the main agent already read, for example by waiting for it, now drops out of the saved session once the conversation no longer mentions it, even if nobody closed it
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because each tool-task record kept in memory is smaller
Reduce reply display delays after resuming sessions with long subagent histories
Resuming a session with many finished subagents uses less memory and does less work when it first reads each of them, because a finished subagent's tool history is no longer copied into the bookkeeping that tracks subagent attempts

title.zh-TW: 補齊工作流程取消拒絕原因與暫停重開狀態
title.en: Clarify Workflow Cancel Refusals and Preserve Pause and Resume State

body.zh-TW:
操作工作流程遇到取消被拒、暫停或重開接續時，以前往往摸不清失敗原因或弄丟額度設定。

當 `muse serve` 拒絕取消某個工作流程時，錯誤訊息裡新增的 `stopRefusal` 欄位會直接寫出確切的拒絕原因，例如 `stale_revision`。

如果取消工作流程的動作遇上工作階段儲存錯誤，`muse serve` 現在會附帶原因正式拒絕，不再直接回傳內部錯誤。

重新接續同一個 Workflow 時，使用者設定的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限會原封不動保留下來。

暫停工作流程時，還沒跑完的背景工作不會再被誤報成遺失結果。過去在取消遇錯時只見內部錯誤、暫停時被報遺失結果，現在每種狀況都有清楚交代與保留。
body.en:
When a workflow cancel was refused, paused, or resumed, it was previously hard to tell why it failed or your limit settings would be lost.

When `muse serve` refuses to cancel a workflow, the new `stopRefusal` field in the error message now names the exact refusal reason, such as `stale_revision`.

If canceling a workflow hits a session storage error, `muse serve` now formally refuses it with a reason instead of returning an internal error.

When resuming the same Workflow, the user's limit on tokens (text units for AI processing and billing) is preserved intact.

When pausing a workflow, unfinished background work is no longer misreported as a missing result. Previously, cancel errors only showed an internal error and pauses reported missing results, whereas now every case is clearly explained and preserved.

items.original:
A workflow cancel that `muse serve` refuses now names the exact stop refusal in the error's new `stopRefusal` field, for example `stale_revision`
A workflow cancel that hits a session storage error is now refused with a reason by `muse serve` instead of failing with an internal error
Resuming the same Workflow preserves the user's token limit
Pausing a workflow no longer reports unfinished background work as a missing result

title.zh-TW: 修正忙碌時的訊息排隊、收回與中斷重送行為
title.en: Fix Message Queuing, Take-Back, and Interrupt Retries While Busy

body.zh-TW:
代理正在忙著處理任務時，你送出的新指令、插話或停止訊號以前常卡在交接空檔裡。⟦拿客滿時段的咖啡廳吧台來說，點單慢一點確認也不會把點單紙退回客人手裡，真要抽單而吧台塞滿時會等一下再請你重試，喊停時服務生也會再喊一聲確保停下。⟧

當代理忙碌時送出或排隊的訊息，若代理確認較慢，不會再跳出「steer failed」並退回輸入框，而是會維持在排隊狀態並順利送達一次。

用來中斷子代理的訊息，在替代的子代理啟動後，就會停止顯示為排隊中。

在 `muse serve` 裡，若某個卡住的工作階段指令佇列已滿，你想收回排隊中的訊息時，不會一直等到工作階段復原，改成在 30 秒後回傳可重試的忙碌錯誤。

按下停止（Stop）時，如果主機回報正在忙碌，Stop 會再次送出中斷訊號，讓執行中的回合真正停下來，不會繼續往下跑。
body.en:
When an agent was busy handling a task, new instructions, interruptions, or stop signals you sent often got stuck in handoff gaps. ⟦Consider a packed coffee counter: even if an order takes a moment to confirm, the ticket is not handed back to the customer, a cancellation at a jammed counter waits briefly before asking you to retry, and a call to stop is echoed again so work actually halts.⟧

A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and returns to the input box if the agent is slow to confirm it; instead, it stays queued and is delivered once.

Messages used to interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued once the replacement subagent starts.

In `muse serve`, if a stuck session's command queue is full and you try to take back a queued message, it no longer waits until the session recovers and instead returns a retryable busy error after 30 seconds.

When you press Stop, if the host says it is busy, Stop sends the interrupt signal again so the running turn actually stops instead of continuing.

items.original:
In `muse serve`, taking back a queued message on a stuck session whose command queue is full now fails after 30 seconds with a busy error you can retry, instead of waiting until the session recovers
Messages that interrupt a subagent stop showing as queued when its replacement starts
Stop sends its interrupt again when the host says it is busy, so the running turn stops instead of running on
A message sent or queued while the agent is busy no longer shows "steer failed" and comes back to the input box when the agent is slow to confirm it; it stays queued and is delivered once

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定為用戶端補齊狀態、錯誤與回執欄位
title.en: Session Protocol Adds Status, Error, and Receipt Fields for Clients

body.zh-TW:
開發自己的操作介面時，若想即時掌握背景執行進度或失敗原因，這套通訊規範（session protocol）現在提供更明確的訊號。

父工作階段在同伺服器開啟時，讀取子代理 `session/read` 會帶 `modelTurnRunning`，標明是否仍在跑模型回合。

`TurnErrorKind` 新增兩個不可重試類型：`reasoningReplayRefused` 為換模型後無法接續，`contextOverflow` 為超出脈絡視窗，既有比對會由預設分支接住。

開啟 Bash 標題時，殼層指令 `toolCall` 會帶安全顯示的短 `bashTitle`，免解析模型原文即可標記。

主體完成回執會以專屬歷史列送達，逾時、被插話轉向或被壓縮的工具主體都能保住結果與展開狀態。
body.en:
When building your own interface, the session protocol now gives clearer signals for tracking background progress or failure causes in real time.

When the parent session is open on the same server, reading a subagent via `session/read` now includes `modelTurnRunning` to indicate whether a model turn is still running.

`TurnErrorKind` adds two non-retryable types: `reasoningReplayRefused` for chats that cannot continue after a model switch, and `contextOverflow` for exceeding the context window; existing matches are caught by their default branch.

While Bash titles are enabled, a shell command `toolCall` carries a short, display-safe `bashTitle` so rows can be labeled without parsing the model's raw text.

Body-completion receipts arrive as dedicated history rows, preserving the results and expansion state of timed-out, steered, or compacted tool bodies.

items.original:
`session/read` of a subagent session now carries `modelTurnRunning`, which says whether the subagent is still running a model turn, when its parent session is open on the same server
`TurnErrorKind` gains `reasoningReplayRefused` (a chat that cannot continue after a model switch) and `contextOverflow` (a turn that cannot fit the model's context window), both not retryable, so session-protocol clients can tell these two failures apart; existing matches receive them in their catch-all arm
A session protocol `toolCall` item of a shell command now carries a short, display-safe title for the command (`bashTitle`) while Bash titles are on, so a client can label the row without parsing the model's raw text
Body-completion receipts now reach session-protocol clients as dedicated history rows, so a timed-out, steered, or compacted-away tool body keeps its result and expansion state on the client instead of dropping them

title.zh-TW: TypeScript SDK 支援傳入模擬主機函式進行測試
title.en: TypeScript SDK Supports Passing a Fake Host Function for Testing

body.zh-TW: 撰寫整合 TypeScript SDK 的工具時，如果測試流程一定得啟動真實的 `muse` 程序，在本機驗證時會綁手綁腳。⟦彷彿飛行員在地面用模擬駕駛艙練習起降流程，不必每次驗證儀表都把真飛機開上跑道。⟧現在 `MuseClient.spawn` 與 `spawnMspConnection` 都接受 `spawnFn` 選項，讓你能直接對記憶體內的模擬主機跑完交握與工作階段。當你準備測試用戶端與工具之間的連線流程時，只要透過 `spawnFn` 接入假主機，就能在記憶體中直接跑完整套工作階段互動，不必真的啟動 `muse` 程序。
body.en: When writing tools that integrate the TypeScript SDK, requiring a real `muse` process for every test makes local verification cumbersome. ⟦Pilots practice takeoffs and landings in a ground cockpit simulator rather than rolling a real aircraft onto the runway every time an instrument needs checking.⟧ Both `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` now accept a `spawnFn` option, letting you run handshakes and sessions against an in-memory fake host. When you are ready to test the connection flow between a client and a tool, you can wire up a fake host through `spawnFn` and run the full session interaction in memory without starting a real `muse` process.

items.original: TypeScript SDK: `MuseClient.spawn` and `spawnMspConnection` accept a `spawnFn` option, so you can run the handshake and sessions against an in-memory fake host instead of a real `muse` process

title.zh-TW: 特定主機工作階段可依管理政策於啟動時調整沙盒與網路
title.en: Sessions on Specific Hosts Can Adjust Sandbox and Network at Start Under Policy

body.zh-TW: 如果用戶端需要讓工作階段在更寬鬆的環境下運行，這項權限現在能在連線之初提出申請。由 `muse serve --per-session` 或 `muse attach --stdio` 啟動的主機上，只要用戶端選擇啟用實驗性 API，工作階段就能在 `session/start` 時關閉沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境）或開啟網路，前提是不能超出管理政策允許的範圍。在團隊允許連網存取特定資源的情境下，用戶端便能在啟動階段直接完成這項調整。⟦試想進大樓實驗室申請開放外網與解除隔離區，就算手上拿著專案的實驗通行證，能開關的幅度依然受到管理規章限制。⟧
body.en: If a client needs a session to run in a less restricted environment, that permission can now be requested right at connection time. On a host started by `muse serve --per-session` or `muse attach --stdio`, as long as the client opts into the experimental API, a session can turn off its sandbox (an isolated, secure execution environment) or open its network at `session/start`, provided it stays within what managed policy allows. In scenarios where a team permits network access to specific resources, the client can complete this adjustment directly during startup. ⟦Entering a building lab to request external network access and lift isolation works the same way: even with an experimental project pass in hand, what you can toggle is still limited by management rules.⟧
